attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this BOM line item. Controls whether the component is included in active MRP runs and procurement planning. Inactive or obsolete lines are retained for historical traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP Module; PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) Governance

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity of this component that must be ordered from the supplier in a single purchase order. Used in procurement planning to ensure order quantities meet supplier MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Minimum Order Quantity (MINBM); MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) Procurement Standard

attributes.name: operation_number
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production routing operation or work center step at which this component is consumed. Enables precise material staging and backflushing in the MES and MRP systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Routing Operation (VORNR); Siemens Opcenter MES

attributes.name: phantom_item_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM line represents a phantom assembly — a logical grouping of components that is not physically stocked or produced as a discrete item but is exploded through in MRP planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Phantom Item Indicator (SHKZL); MRP (Material Requirements Planning)

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.description: The EU REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals) registration number for this chemical component. Required for substances manufactured or imported into the EU above threshold quantities.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; European Chemicals Agency (ECHA)

attributes.name: recursive_bom_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component itself has a subordinate BOM (i.e., it is a sub-assembly or semi-finished good with its own BOM structure). Used to identify multi-level BOM explosion requirements in MRP planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Multi-Level BOM Explosion; MRP (Material Requirements Planning)

attributes.name: required_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the component required to produce one unit of the parent SKU at the base quantity defined in the BOM header. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_QUANTITY category. Supports MRP and COGS calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP Module - BOM Component Quantity (MENGE); MRP (Material Requirements Planning)

attributes.name: scrap_percentage
attributes.description: The expected percentage of this component that will be lost or wasted during the manufacturing process. Used to inflate the planned component quantity in MRP runs and COGS calculations. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 2.5 = 2.5%).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Component Scrap (AUSSS); GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice)

attributes.name: sds_document_number
attributes.description: The document number or reference identifier for the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) associated with this hazardous component. Links to the SDS stored in Veeva Vault or the document management system for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200; EU REACH Regulation; Veeva Vault Quality Documents; SDS (Safety Data Sheet)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the operational system of record from which this BOM line was sourced (e.g., SAP_S4HANA, ORACLE_ERP). Supports data lineage tracking and multi-system reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Lineage Standards; SAP S/4HANA; Oracle Cloud ERP

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: The designated warehouse storage location or bin where this component is staged for production consumption. Used by WMS and MES for material staging, goods issue, and FEFO/FIFO inventory management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA WM Module - Storage Location (LGORT); Blue Yonder WMS; FEFO (First Expired First Out); FIFO (First In First Out)

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the required quantity of the component (e.g., KG, L, EA, M, G). Must align with the component material master UOM. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT category (measurement dimension).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Base Unit of Measure (MEINS); GS1 UN/ECE Recommendation 20

attributes.name: usage_probability_pct
attributes.description: The probability (expressed as a percentage, 0–100) that this alternative component will actually be used in production. Used by MRP to calculate weighted component requirements across alternative item groups.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Usage Probability (EWAHR)

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this BOM line is effective and should be included in production and MRP planning. Supports date-effective BOM management for product reformulations and packaging changes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - BOM Valid From Date (DATUV); PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date after which this BOM line is no longer effective and should be excluded from production and MRP planning. Null indicates the line is open-ended with no planned expiry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - BOM Valid To Date (DATUB); PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)

products.name: formulation
products.description: Formulation master record capturing the approved chemical or ingredient recipe for a consumer goods product (household, personal care, health, or hygiene). Stores formulation code, version number, formulation name, product category, regulatory approval status, pH range, viscosity, color, fragrance code, preservative system, and the R&D project reference. Tracks the full formulation lifecycle from lab development through commercial approval. Sourced from Veeva Vault PLM.

attributes.name: formulation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the formulation master record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for all downstream joins and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: R&D formulations are owned by specific cost centers for R&D spend tracking, capitalization decisions, and regulatory compliance costing. Consumer goods companies assign formulations to R&D cost center

attributes.name: product_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_category. Business justification: Formulation table stores product_category as string. Formulations are typically developed for specific product categories (skincare, haircare, etc.). This should be normalized to FK to product_categor

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) document associated with this formulation, stored in Veeva Vault. Required under OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HazCom) and EU REACH for hazardous substances.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200; EU REACH Regulation; Veeva Vault Regulatory Submissions

attributes.name: active_ingredient_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary active ingredient in the formulation (e.g., 'Salicylic Acid', 'Zinc Pyrithione', 'Fluoride'). Required for OTC drug product regulatory filings with FDA and for consumer-facing efficacy claims.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21 OTC Monographs; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: active_ingredient_pct
attributes.description: Concentration of the primary active ingredient expressed as a weight percentage (w/w%) of the total formulation. Proprietary trade secret data. Governs regulatory classification (OTC drug vs. cosmetic), label claims, and dosage compliance.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21; EU REACH Regulation; ISO 22716

attributes.name: allergen_declaration
attributes.description: Free-text or structured declaration of regulated allergens present in the formulation above threshold concentrations (e.g., EU 26 listed fragrance allergens, FDA major food allergens for food-contact products). Required for consumer safety labeling.
attributes.references: EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009 Annex III; FDA CFR Title 21; IFRA Standards

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the formulation received final commercial approval in the PLM system. Marks the transition from regulatory review to approved lifecycle stage and triggers manufacturing authorization.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: bom_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference code linking this formulation to the corresponding Bill of Materials (BOM) in SAP S/4HANA PP/MM. Enables traceability between the approved formulation recipe and the manufacturing BOM used for production planning and Material Requirements Planning (MRP).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM; ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the formulation within the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system. Sourced from Veeva Vault PLM and used as the cross-system business key across SAP S/4HANA QM and Siemens Opcenter MES.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: color_description
attributes.description: Standardized color description of the finished formulation as specified in the quality standard (e.g., 'White to off-white', 'Clear colorless', 'Pale yellow'). Used in visual QC inspection and consumer safety documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this formulation record was first created in the source PLM system (Veeva Vault). Provides audit trail for formulation lifecycle tracking and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; ISO 9001; SOX

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this formulation version is authorized for use in commercial manufacturing. May differ from approval_date when a transition period is required to consume existing raw material stocks.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP; ISO 9001

attributes.name: formulation_type
attributes.description: Physical form classification of the formulation describing its physicochemical structure. Drives manufacturing process selection, packaging requirements, and stability testing protocols. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: emulsion|solution|suspension|gel|powder|foam|aerosol|solid — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 22716; FDA CFR Title 21; Siemens Opcenter MES

attributes.name: fragrance_code
attributes.description: Proprietary or supplier-assigned code identifying the fragrance ingredient blend used in this formulation. Required for IFRA compliance assessment, allergen declaration, and INCI ingredient listing on product labels.
attributes.references: IFRA (International Fragrance Association) Standards; EU REACH Regulation; ISO 22716

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the formulation has been developed and validated in compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standards. Required for commercial manufacturing authorization and regulatory audit readiness.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 - Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics; FDA 21 CFR Part 111; GMP

attributes.name: inci_declaration
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) Declaration
attributes.description: Full International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) ingredient list for the formulation in descending order of concentration, as required for product label compliance. Sourced from Veeva Vault regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: INCI (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients); EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009; FDA CFR Title 21 Part 701

tag_set.value: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) Declaration

attributes.name: intended_use
attributes.description: Declared intended use or application of the formulation (e.g., 'Rinse-off body wash for daily use', 'Leave-on facial moisturizer', 'Hard surface disinfectant cleaner'). Determines regulatory classification pathway and labeling requirements.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21; EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009; CPSC; EPA

attributes.name: is_cruelty_free
attributes.description: Indicates whether the formulation and its constituent ingredients have not been tested on animals. Supports cruelty-free certification claims and compliance with EU animal testing ban under Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009.
attributes.references: EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009 Article 18; FTC Advertising and Labeling Guidelines

attributes.name: is_fragrance_free
attributes.description: Indicates whether the formulation contains no added fragrance ingredients. Drives consumer-facing label claims, regulatory declarations, and product positioning for sensitive-skin or hypoallergenic product lines.
attributes.references: FTC (Federal Trade Commission) Advertising and Labeling; EU REACH Regulation; FDA CFR Title 21

attributes.name: is_vegan
attributes.description: Indicates whether the formulation contains no animal-derived ingredients or by-products. Supports consumer-facing vegan label claims and retailer listing requirements for vegan-certified product ranges.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising and Labeling Guidelines; ISO 22716

attributes.name: lab_notebook_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the electronic laboratory notebook (ELN) entry or physical lab notebook record documenting the original formulation development experiments. Provides scientific traceability for regulatory submissions and IP protection.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; FDA 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this formulation record in the source PLM system. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 - Electronic Records; ISO 9001; SOX

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the formulation in the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) workflow, from initial lab development through commercial approval and eventual obsolescence. Governs which business processes may consume this formulation record.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; ISO 9001 - Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the formulation as registered in the PLM system (e.g., 'Moisturizing Body Lotion Base v2 - Fragrance Free'). Used in regulatory submissions, quality documents, and R&D reporting.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; ISO 22716 - Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics

attributes.name: obsolescence_date
attributes.description: Date on which this formulation version was or is scheduled to be retired and replaced by a newer version. Null for currently active formulations. Used in manufacturing planning to manage version transitions.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP; ISO 9001

attributes.name: ph_max
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable pH value of the formulation as defined in the approved specification. Together with ph_min, defines the pH range tolerance band for quality control (QC) release testing and in-process checks.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 - Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics; FDA CFR Title 21; OECD Guidelines for Testing of Chemicals

attributes.name: ph_min
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable pH value of the formulation as defined in the approved specification. Used in quality control (QC) testing and stability assessments. pH range is a critical quality attribute (CQA) for consumer safety and product efficacy.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 - Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics; FDA CFR Title 21; OECD Guidelines for Testing of Chemicals

attributes.name: preservative_system
attributes.description: Description or code identifying the preservative system used in the formulation (e.g., 'Phenoxyethanol/Ethylhexylglycerin', 'Benzalkonium Chloride', 'Paraben-free system'). Critical for regulatory compliance, challenge testing, and consumer safety claims.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation; FDA CFR Title 21; ISO 22716; INCI Nomenclature

attributes.name: rd_project_code
attributes.description: Reference code linking this formulation to the originating Research and Development (R&D) / New Product Development (NPD) project in the PLM system. Enables traceability from commercial formulation back to the innovation pipeline.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.description: European Chemicals Agency (ECHA) registration number assigned under EU REACH Regulation for substances manufactured or imported above 1 tonne per year. Required for market access in the European Union.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory approval status of the formulation as assessed against applicable jurisdictional requirements (FDA, EU REACH, CPSC). Determines whether the formulation may be used in commercial manufacturing. Distinct from internal PLM lifecycle stage.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21; EU REACH Regulation; CPSC; ISO 22716

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory product classification determining the applicable compliance framework and submission pathway. Drives FDA, EPA, or CPSC filing requirements and labeling obligations.
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21; EPA; CPSC; EU REACH Regulation; EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009

attributes.name: rspo_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) Certified Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether palm oil or palm-derived ingredients in this formulation are sourced from Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) certified supply chains. Supports sustainability reporting and retailer ESG requirements.
attributes.references: RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil); ISO 14001 - Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Native record identifier of this formulation in the originating source system (Veeva Vault PLM). Enables bidirectional traceability between the Databricks Silver Layer and the system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act Financial Reporting

attributes.name: stability_period_months
attributes.description: Approved shelf-life stability period of the formulation expressed in months, as determined by accelerated and real-time stability studies. Drives product expiry date calculation, FEFO inventory management, and label 'best before' declarations.
attributes.references: ISO 22716; FDA CFR Title 21; EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009; ICH Q1A Stability Guidelines

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Specified storage conditions required to maintain formulation integrity and stability (e.g., 'Store below 25°C, away from direct sunlight', 'Refrigerate at 2-8°C'). Used in warehouse management (WMS), logistics planning, and label compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 22716; FDA CFR Title 21; Blue Yonder WMS; ICH Q1A

attributes.name: total_solid_content_pct
attributes.description: Total solid content of the formulation expressed as weight percentage (w/w%). Key physical property used in manufacturing process design, packaging compatibility assessment, and stability testing protocols.
attributes.references: ISO 22716; OECD Guidelines for Testing of Chemicals

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of the formulation record following semantic versioning (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0.1). Each approved change to the formulation recipe increments the version. Enables full formulation lifecycle traceability from lab development through commercial approval.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; ISO 9001 - Document Control

attributes.name: viscosity_max_cps
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable viscosity of the formulation measured in centipoise (cPs) at the specified test temperature. Together with viscosity_min_cps, defines the viscosity tolerance band for quality control (QC) release and in-process testing.

attributes.name: claim_text

attributes.name: country_of_origin

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: distributor_name

attributes.name: expiry_date

attributes.name: gtin

attributes.name: ingredient_declaration_text

domains.name: manufacturing

attributes.name: installed_power_kw

products.name: manufacturing_bom
products.description: Bill of Materials master record (header + component lines) defining the complete material structure for each finished good or semi-finished SKU. Header captures BOM number, BOM type (production, co-product, phantom), base quantity, unit of measure, validity dates, PLM system reference, and BOM status. Component lines capture item number, material reference (raw material, packaging, semi-finished), component quantity per base quantity, scrap factor percentage, item category (stock, non-stock, phantom), INCI name for cosmetic ingredients, allergen flag, hazardous material flag, and component validity dates. SSOT for MRP explosion, production order material requirements, COGS calculation, and regulatory ingredient disclosure per FDA/EU REACH. This is the single authoritative source for all BOM component data — no separate component entity exists.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Bill of Materials (CS01/CS02)

attributes.name: manufacturing_bom_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bill of materials record. Primary key for the manufacturing BOM entity.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.manufacturing_facility. Business justification: Manufacturing BOMs are plant-specific in consumer goods ERP systems — the same product may have different BOMs at different facilities due to local sourcing, equipment capabilities, or regulatory requ

attributes.name: primary_manufacturing_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished good or semi-finished SKU that this BOM defines. Links to the product master for which this material structure applies.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Trade Item Number Standards

attributes.name: product_bom_id

attributes.name: supplier_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier_site. Business justification: GMP and quality approvals in consumer goods are site-specific. A BOM component must reference the qualified supplier SITE (not just supplier) for sourcing compliance, quality audits, and approved supp

attributes.name: alternative_item_group
attributes.description: Identifier for a group of interchangeable components that can substitute for each other in production. Used for supply chain flexibility, multi-sourcing strategies, and material availability optimization.

attributes.name: alternative_item_priority
attributes.description: The selection priority for this component within its alternative item group. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used by MRP to determine preferred material selection when multiple alternatives are available.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when this BOM version was formally approved for production use. Establishes the official release date for regulatory compliance and change control purposes.

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: backflush_indicator

attributes.name: base_quantity
attributes.description: The reference quantity of the finished good for which the component quantities are defined. Typically 1 unit, 100 units, or 1 batch. All component quantities are expressed per this base quantity.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the base quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, L for liter, BOX for box). Must align with the SKU primary UOM.

attributes.name: bom_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique business identifier for this BOM, typically assigned by the PLM or ERP system. Used for cross-system reference and production order material requirements.

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the BOM. Active BOMs are used for production planning and MRP runs. Inactive or obsolete BOMs are retained for historical reference and regulatory traceability.

attributes.name: bom_type
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM structure. Production BOM is used for standard manufacturing, co-product for joint production scenarios, phantom for intermediate assemblies not stocked, engineering for R&D prototypes, and planning for demand forecasting.

attributes.name: component_effective_end_date

attributes.name: component_effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this specific component becomes valid within the BOM structure. Supports phased material transitions, supplier changes, and cost optimization initiatives.

attributes.name: component_item_category

attributes.name: component_item_number

attributes.name: component_quantity

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP BOM Component Quantity

attributes.name: component_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the component quantity (e.g., KG for raw materials, EA for packaging units, L for liquids). Must align with the component material master UOM.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of total product cost attributed to this component. Used for COGS calculation, profitability analysis, and cost optimization initiatives. Sum of all component cost allocations should equal 100% for the BOM.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and regulatory compliance documentation per ISO 9001 requirements.

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag

attributes.name: inci_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) Name
attributes.description: The standardized INCI name for cosmetic ingredients as required by FDA and EU regulations. Used for product labeling, regulatory submissions, and consumer transparency. Mandatory for personal care and cosmetic products.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM record was last updated. Tracks formulation changes, component substitutions, and regulatory updates. Critical for change control and GMP compliance.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The procurement or production lead time for this component in days. Used for MRP scheduling, production order release timing, and inventory planning. Includes supplier lead time plus internal processing time.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP MRP Lead Time Scheduling

attributes.name: lot_size_requirement
attributes.description: Defines the lot sizing rule for this component in production orders. Exact requires precise quantity, minimum allows overages, multiple requires quantities in specific increments, none has no restriction. Impacts material planning and waste management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Lot Sizing Procedures

attributes.name: minimum_lot_size
attributes.description: The minimum quantity that must be procured or produced for this component. Driven by supplier MOQ, production batch constraints, or economic order quantity calculations. Nullable if no minimum applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Minimum Order Quantity

attributes.name: plm_system_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier linking this BOM to the source PLM system record. Enables traceability to engineering change orders, formulation documents, and R&D specifications.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_notes

attributes.name: scrap_factor_percentage

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Certification or standard that this component meets for sustainable sourcing (e.g., FSC for paper, RSPO for palm oil, Fair Trade, Organic). Used for corporate sustainability reporting and consumer transparency initiatives.
attributes.references: FSC Chain of Custody, RSPO Certification

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the BOM structure. Incremented when material composition changes due to reformulation, cost optimization, or regulatory compliance updates. Supports change control and audit trail.

products.name: routing
products.description: Production routing master (header + operation steps) defining the complete manufacturing process sequence for a finished or semi-finished SKU. Header captures routing number, routing type (standard, reference, rate), base quantity, plant, validity dates, and total standard lead time. Operation steps capture operation number, work center assignment, standard values (setup time, machine time, labor time), control key (internal processing, external processing, milestone), yield quantity, scrap percentage, GMP critical step flag, and IPC checkpoint flag. SSOT for production scheduling, capacity planning, standard cost calculation, and GMP batch record generation per ISO 22716. This is the single authoritative source for all routing operation data — no separate operation entity exists. Aligned with SAP PP Routing master.

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production routing master record. Primary key.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.manufacturing_facility. Business justification: A production routing is plant-specific in ERP systems (SAP, Oracle). The routing table already carries a plant_code STRING column which is a denormalized reference to the manufacturing facility. Addin

attributes.name: product_bom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Bill of Materials (BOM) that defines the raw materials and components consumed by this routing. Links routing to material requirements.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished or semi-finished SKU that this routing defines the manufacturing process for.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the routing for production use. Approved routings are validated and authorized; pending routings await review; rejected routings require rework.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this routing was approved for production use. Supports audit trail and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: base_quantity
attributes.description: Standard production lot size for which the routing operation times and resource requirements are defined. Used as the basis for scaling production schedules.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the base quantity (e.g., KG, L, EA, M). Aligns with GS1 unit codes.

attributes.name: changeover_time_minutes
attributes.description: Time required to transition production lines from the previous product to this routing. Critical for production scheduling and minimizing downtime.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the standard cost amount.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this routing record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the routing, including its purpose, scope, and any special instructions for production planners and shop floor operators.

attributes.name: expected_scrap_percentage
attributes.description: Overall expected scrap percentage for the routing, representing anticipated waste or defects. Used for material planning and cost estimation.

attributes.name: expected_yield_percentage
attributes.description: Overall expected yield percentage for the routing, representing the ratio of good output to total input. Used for production planning and variance analysis.

attributes.name: gmp_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this routing includes GMP-critical operations requiring enhanced documentation, validation, and compliance controls per ISO 22716 and FDA regulations.

attributes.name: ipc_checkpoint_count
attributes.description: Number of in-process control checkpoints defined in this routing. IPC checkpoints are quality inspection points during production per ISO 22716 and GMP requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this routing record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: lot_size_restriction
attributes.description: Constraint on production lot sizes for this routing. Fixed requires exact base quantity; minimum/maximum define bounds; multiple requires lot sizes to be multiples of base quantity; none allows any lot size.

attributes.name: maximum_lot_size
attributes.description: Maximum production lot size allowed for this routing. Nullable if no maximum constraint exists.

attributes.name: minimum_lot_size
attributes.description: Minimum production lot size allowed for this routing. Nullable if no minimum constraint exists.

attributes.name: operation_sequence
attributes.description: JSON array or delimited string capturing the complete sequence of operation steps. Each operation includes: operation_number, work_center_code, operation_description, control_key (internal_processing|external_processing|milestone), setup_time_minutes, machine_time_minutes, labor_time_minutes, yield_quantity, scrap_percentage, gmp_critical_step_flag, ipc_checkpoint_flag. This is the single authoritative source for all routing operation data — no separate operation entity exists.

attributes.name: production_scheduler_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the production scheduling strategy or algorithm used for this routing (e.g., forward scheduling, backward scheduling, finite capacity).

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the routing. Externally-known unique code used in production planning and scheduling systems.

attributes.name: routing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the routing. Active routings are available for production scheduling; draft routings are under development; inactive routings are temporarily disabled; obsolete routings are retired; under_review routings are pending approval.

attributes.name: routing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the routing defining its usage pattern. Standard routings are default production paths; reference routings are templates; rate routings define production rates; alternative routings provide backup paths; special routings are for one-time or custom production runs.

attributes.name: standard_cost_amount
attributes.description: Standard production cost per base quantity for this routing, including labor, machine, and overhead costs. Used for cost accounting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: total_labor_time_minutes
attributes.description: Cumulative labor time across all operations in the routing, used for workforce planning and standard cost calculation.

attributes.name: total_machine_time_minutes
attributes.description: Cumulative machine processing time across all operations in the routing, used for capacity planning and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) calculations.

attributes.name: total_setup_time_minutes
attributes.description: Cumulative setup time across all operations in the routing, used for capacity planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: total_standard_lead_time_hours
attributes.description: Total cumulative lead time in hours required to complete all operations in this routing, including setup, processing, and queue times. Used for Material Requirements Planning (MRP) and capacity planning.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this routing becomes effective and available for production scheduling.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this routing remains effective. Nullable for open-ended routings.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the routing, enabling tracking of routing changes over time. Supports engineering change management and audit trails.

products.name: production_order
products.description: Core transactional record representing a manufacturing production order issued to produce a specific SKU quantity at a facility. Captures order number, order type (PP01 standard, PP03 rework), SKU reference, plant, production line, scheduled start/finish dates, actual start/finish dates, order quantity, confirmed quantity, scrap quantity, order status (created, released, partially confirmed, technically complete, closed), MRP controller, and cost object. SSOT for production execution tracking in SAP S/4HANA PP.

attributes.name: production_order_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: gl_account_id

attributes.name: inspection_plan_id

attributes.name: manufacturing_bom_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.manufacturing_bom. Business justification: Production order consumes a specific manufacturing BOM; adding manufacturing_bom_id FK connects BOM to order and eliminates isolation of manufacturing_bom.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.manufacturing_facility. Business justification: Production order compliance reporting requires linking each order to the product's registration record to verify GMP compliance and traceability.

attributes.name: product_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_category. Business justification: Pilot production orders are generated from R&D projects; the Production Planning system needs the project ID to track development cost and schedule.

attributes.name: production_line_id

attributes.name: actual_cost

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp

attributes.name: batch_number

attributes.name: changeover_time_minutes

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: downtime_minutes

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent update to the production order record. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: material_number

attributes.name: mrp_controller

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: theoretical_yield_percentage
attributes.description: Expected yield percentage based on Bill of Materials (BOM) specifications and standard operating procedures. Baseline for variance analysis.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

attributes.name: yield_loss_reason_code

attributes.name: yield_variance_percentage
attributes.description: Variance between actual and theoretical yield expressed as percentage. Calculated as (actual_yield_percentage - theoretical_yield_percentage). Negative values indicate yield loss.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, SAP S/4HANA CO Variance Analysis

products.name: planned_order
products.description: Production planning record representing the complete planning pipeline from S&OP/IBP through MRP execution to production order conversion. Encompasses both Master Production Schedule (MPS) entries (planned quantities by SKU/facility/period with schedule versioning) and MRP-generated planned orders (system-proposed production or procurement proposals). Captures planned order ID, order type (MPS, MRP planned, CBP), SKU, plant, MRP run reference, planned quantity, scheduled start/finish dates, planning period (week/month), schedule version, S&OP cycle reference, IBP plan version, firming indicator, schedule status (draft, firmed, released, converted, deleted), exception message code, planner ID, and conversion status. SSOT for MRP exception management, MPS governance, and the complete production planning pipeline from demand signal through to production order creation.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The consumer's country of residence in ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 format (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'DEU'). Determines applicable regulatory framework (GDPR for EU, CCPA for California), tax jurisdiction, and localized product availability.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 3; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when this shopper record was first created in the Consumer Goods data platform. Serves as the authoritative audit trail for record creation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has consented to sharing their personal data with third-party partners (e.g., retail partners, market research firms such as Nielsen IQ). TRUE = consented; FALSE = not consented. Critical for GDPR Article 6 lawful basis and CCPA opt-out compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 & 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; FTC Privacy Guidelines

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred display name or alias used in digital channels, loyalty portals, and personalized marketing communications. May differ from legal name.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Contact Object; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: email_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has provided explicit opt-in consent to receive email marketing communications. TRUE = consented; FALSE = not consented or withdrawn. Mandatory suppression flag for GDPR/CCPA compliance in all outbound email campaigns.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 & 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; CAN-SPAM Act; CASL

attributes.name: family_name
attributes.description: The consumer's legal family name (surname) as captured at registration or identity verification. Combined with given_name to form the full legal identity for CRM, personalization, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: gdpr_subject
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consumer is a GDPR data subject (i.e., located in the EU/EEA and subject to GDPR protections). TRUE = GDPR applies; FALSE = not a GDPR subject. Drives data processing lawful basis checks, right-to-erasure workflows, and data portability requests.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3 & 4; EU REACH Regulation (data subject scope)

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: The consumer's self-reported gender identity. Used for consumer segmentation, personalized product recommendations, and inclusive marketing. Collected with explicit consent per GDPR/CCPA.

attributes.name: given_name
attributes.description: The consumer's legal given name (first name) as captured at registration or identity verification. Used for personalized communications, CRM, and regulatory subject identification under GDPR/CCPA.

attributes.name: identity_verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consumer's identity was most recently verified (yyyy-MM-dd). Used to assess verification recency and trigger re-verification workflows for high-risk transactions or regulatory audits.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; NIST SP 800-63; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Identity Verification

attributes.name: identity_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer's identity has been formally verified through an identity verification process (e.g., email confirmation, document verification, phone OTP). TRUE = verified; FALSE = unverified. Affects eligibility for high-value loyalty redemptions and DTC account features.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (data accuracy); CCPA Section 1798.130; NIST SP 800-63 Digital Identity Guidelines

attributes.name: last_purchase_date
attributes.description: The date of the consumer's most recent confirmed purchase transaction across any channel (DTC, retail POS, e-commerce). Used for recency scoring in RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) analysis, churn prediction, and re-engagement campaign triggers.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Last Activity Date; SAP S/4HANA SD — Last Order Date

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current state of the consumer record in the lifecycle. 'active' = engaged consumer; 'inactive' = no activity within defined period; 'opted_out' = consumer has withdrawn consent and must not be contacted; 'suspended' = account temporarily restricted; 'pending_verification' = identity not yet confirmed. Drives GDPR/CCPA suppression logic.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 & 17; CCPA Section 1798.120; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: loyalty_enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date the consumer formally enrolled in the loyalty program (yyyy-MM-dd). Used to calculate loyalty tenure, anniversary rewards, and cohort-based loyalty analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Enrollment Date

attributes.name: loyalty_points_balance
attributes.description: The current redeemable loyalty points balance held by the consumer. This is the raw operational balance as recorded in the loyalty system — not a calculated aggregate. Used for redemption eligibility checks and consumer-facing balance display.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Points; ISO 4217 (currency-equivalent valuation)

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: The most recently recorded Net Promoter Score (NPS) for this consumer, on a scale of 0–10. NPS is the industry-standard metric for measuring consumer loyalty and likelihood to recommend. Supports consumer satisfaction analytics and brand health reporting.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company / Satmetrix); Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent NPS survey response was recorded for this consumer. Used to assess recency of satisfaction data and trigger re-survey workflows.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company); Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Survey Response Date

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: The consumer's residential postal or ZIP code. Used for geographic segmentation, regional marketing campaigns, distribution territory assignment, and retail proximity analysis (OSA, planogram relevance).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; GS1 Address Standards

attributes.name: preferred_currency
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred transaction currency in ISO 4217 three-letter code (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Used for DTC pricing display, loyalty point valuation, and cross-border e-commerce personalization.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred communication language in IETF BCP 47 format (e.g., 'en-US', 'fr-FR', 'es-MX'). Drives localization of marketing communications, product labels, and digital experience personalization.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47; ISO 639-1; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Language Preference

attributes.name: preferred_store_banner
attributes.description: The consumer's self-reported or behaviorally-inferred preferred retail store banner or chain (e.g., 'Walmart', 'Target', 'Kroger'). Used for retail execution targeting, trade promotion personalization, and channel affinity analytics in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Retail Execution; TradeEdge Channel Visibility; Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: The primary email address used for all consumer communications, loyalty program enrollment, DTC order confirmations, and digital marketing. Serves as the principal digital identity key in CRM and Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: The consumer's primary contact phone number in E.164 international format. Used for SMS marketing, two-factor authentication, consumer care, and DTC order notifications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: push_notification_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has opted in to receive push notifications via the brand's mobile application. TRUE = opted in; FALSE = opted out or not set. Drives mobile engagement campaign eligibility.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 & 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; Apple APNS / Google FCM Consent Guidelines

attributes.name: registration_source_url
attributes.description: The URL or digital touchpoint from which the consumer completed their registration (e.g., brand website landing page, DTC checkout, loyalty sign-up page). Supports digital marketing attribution and campaign source tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Lead Source URL; FTC Digital Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: sms_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has provided explicit opt-in consent to receive SMS/text marketing communications. TRUE = consented; FALSE = not consented or withdrawn. Required for TCPA compliance in the US and equivalent regulations globally.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 & 7; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: source_system_consumer_ref
attributes.description: The consumer's unique identifier as recorded in the originating source system (e.g., SAP Business Partner ID, Salesforce Contact ID, DTC platform user ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation, MDM golden record matching, and audit traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Business Partner ID; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Contact ID; Oracle Cloud ERP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when this shopper record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

products.name: household
products.description: Household unit grouping multiple shoppers who share a residence and purchasing decisions. Captures household demographics (estimated size, income band, life stage), formation date, status, and primary shopper designation. Enables household-level basket analysis, cross-sell targeting (e.g., recommending baby products when life stage changes), and loyalty program household pooling for CPG/FMCG brands.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the household record in the Consumer Goods lakehouse. Primary key for all household-level analytics, loyalty pooling, and basket analysis.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program under which this household is enrolled for points pooling and reward redemption.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Trade Promotion

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consumer.loyalty_tier. Business justification: household.loyalty_tier is a denormalized STRING storing the household's aggregate loyalty tier. The loyalty_tier table is the authoritative reference. Adding loyalty_tier_id FK normalizes this and ena

attributes.name: merged_from_household_id
attributes.description: Reference to the source household record that was merged into this household during deduplication or household consolidation. Null if no merge has occurred. Supports data lineage and audit trails.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM; GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy)

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the designated primary shopper or head-of-household consumer profile. Used to anchor loyalty program pooling and personalization targeting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Account Management

attributes.name: brand_affinity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has demonstrated strong brand loyalty to the company's portfolio based on repeat purchase patterns and SOV (Share of Voice) analysis. Used for brand marketing investment decisions.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Account Management

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has exercised the right to opt out of the sale of personal information under CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act). Mandatory compliance field for California-resident households.

attributes.name: children_present_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether children under 18 are present in the household. Key trigger for cross-sell targeting of baby, child health, and family-oriented CPG/FMCG product categories.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel Life Stage Segmentation; COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act)

attributes.name: cltv_band
attributes.description: Categorical CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) band assigned to the household based on historical purchase behavior and predictive modeling. Used for investment prioritization in trade promotion and personalization.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Account Management

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the household, used in CRM, loyalty, and DTC channel communications. Distinct from the surrogate primary key.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Location Number (GLN) Standards; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM

attributes.name: consent_last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to any consent or privacy preference for the household. Critical for GDPR/CCPA audit trails and demonstrating lawful basis for data processing.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country of the household's primary residence. Used for regulatory compliance (GDPR, CCPA) and international market segmentation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 3; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the household record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and GDPR/CCPA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Originating system or channel from which the household record was first created or last enriched. Used for data lineage, quality scoring, and source system reconciliation in the lakehouse. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: crm|loyalty_program|ecommerce|panel|pos|dtc|manual — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM; TradeEdge

attributes.name: digital_engagement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household actively engages with the brand through digital channels (e-commerce, mobile app, social media). Used for DTC (Direct to Consumer) channel strategy and omnichannel personalization.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution; GDPR Article 6

attributes.name: dissolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the household was dissolved, merged, or deactivated. Null for active households. Used for lifecycle reporting and GDPR/CCPA data retention compliance.

attributes.name: dwelling_type
attributes.description: Type of residential dwelling occupied by the household. Used for product category targeting (e.g., home care, cleaning products) and basket size normalization in CPG analytics.

attributes.name: estimated_size
attributes.description: Estimated number of individuals residing in the household. Used for basket size normalization, per-capita consumption analysis, and product volume forecasting in S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning).
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel; SAP IBP Demand Planning

attributes.name: formation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the household record was first established in the system, representing when the household unit was recognized as a distinct entity for loyalty and analytics purposes.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has provided valid consent for data processing under GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation). Mandatory for EU-resident households before any marketing or analytics processing.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Broad geographic region of the household's residence (e.g., Northeast, Southeast, Midwest, West, Southwest). Used for regional demand planning and distribution channel management.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning; Nielsen IQ Market Intelligence

attributes.name: household_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the household record. 'merged' indicates consolidation with another household; 'dissolved' indicates the household no longer exists as a unit.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure)

attributes.name: household_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the household composition used for segmentation and cross-sell targeting in CPG/FMCG analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single|couple|family|multi_generational|shared_living|other — promote to reference product if values expand]
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel Segmentation Standards

attributes.name: income_band
attributes.description: Estimated annual household income bracket used for consumer segmentation, RSP (Recommended Selling Price) sensitivity analysis, and premium product targeting. Derived from third-party panel data or self-reported.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel Income Segmentation; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the household record. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse Silver layer and data freshness monitoring.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; ISO 8601; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: life_stage
attributes.description: Life stage classification of the household used for targeted marketing and NPD (New Product Development) insights (e.g., young_single, young_couple_no_children, family_with_young_children, family_with_teens, empty_nester, retired). Enables cross-sell triggers such as recommending baby products when life stage transitions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: young_single|young_couple_no_children|family_with_young_children|family_with_teens|empty_nester|retired|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel Life Stage Segmentation; SAP IBP Demand Planning Segmentation

attributes.name: loyalty_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the household was enrolled in the loyalty program. Used to calculate loyalty tenure, tier progression timelines, and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) cohort analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Trade Promotion

attributes.name: loyalty_points_balance
attributes.description: Current unredeemed loyalty points balance accumulated at the household level across all member consumers. Supports household-level pooling for CPG/FMCG loyalty programs.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Trade Promotion; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Strategic consumer market segment assigned to the household for brand marketing and consumer engagement programs (e.g., health_conscious, value_seeker, premium_buyer, eco_friendly). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: health_conscious|value_seeker|premium_buyer|eco_friendly|convenience_driven|brand_loyal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel Segmentation; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Account Management

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has opted in to receive marketing communications (email, SMS, push notifications) from the brand. Governs eligibility for trade promotion and consumer engagement campaigns.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA Section 1798.120; FTC CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the household, typically the primary shopper's surname or a family name used for display in CRM and loyalty program communications.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent NPS (Net Promoter Score) recorded for the household, ranging from 0 to 10. Used to classify households as Promoters (9-10), Passives (7-8), or Detractors (0-6) for consumer engagement programs.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company); Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent NPS (Net Promoter Score) survey response was recorded for the household. Used to assess recency of satisfaction data for consumer engagement decisions.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company); Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM

attributes.name: panel_member_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household is an active member of a consumer research panel (e.g., Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel). Panel households provide purchase diary data used for market intelligence and SOM (Share of Market) analysis.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel; ISO 20252 (Market Research Standards)

attributes.name: pet_owner_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household owns pets. Used for targeted marketing of pet care product categories and cross-sell recommendations within the CPG/FMCG portfolio.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Account Management

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the household's primary residence. Used for geographic clustering, DRP (Distribution Requirements Planning), and localized trade promotion targeting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; GS1 Address Standards

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: BCP 47 language tag representing the household's preferred communication language (e.g., en-US, es-MX, fr-FR). Used for localized marketing content, product labeling compliance, and consumer engagement personalization.
attributes.references: BCP 47 Language Tag Standard; GDPR Article 12 (Transparent Communication); FTC Advertising Standards

attributes.name: primary_channel
attributes.description: The dominant channel through which the household makes purchases. Used for DTC (Direct to Consumer) strategy, channel mix analysis, and trade promotion targeting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution; TradeEdge Channel Visibility

attributes.name: primary_retailer_banner
attributes.description: The retail banner or chain where the household conducts the majority of its grocery or consumer goods shopping (e.g., Walmart, Target, Kroger). Used for OSA (On Shelf Availability) and POG (Planogram) analytics.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement; TradeEdge Secondary Sales

attributes.name: private_label_buyer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household regularly purchases private label or store-brand products in addition to or instead of branded CPG products. Used for competitive analysis and brand switching risk assessment.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel; TradeEdge Channel Visibility

attributes.name: purchase_frequency_band
attributes.description: Categorical band representing how frequently the household makes purchases across CPG/FMCG categories. Derived from POS (Point of Sale) transaction history and used for demand sensing and replenishment planning.
attributes.references: TradeEdge Demand Sensing; Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel

attributes.name: tenure_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household owns or rents their residence. Used for home improvement and home care product category targeting and consumer segmentation.

products.name: address
products.description: Physical and digital address records associated with a consumer/shopper. Stores address type (billing, shipping, home, work), street lines, city, state/province, postal code, country, geocoordinates (latitude/longitude), address validation status, address source, effective date, and expiry date. Supports DTC order fulfillment, personalized marketing, and regulatory compliance for GDPR/CCPA data residency requirements.

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each consumer address record in the Consumer Goods DTC/B2C platform. Primary key for the consumer_address data product.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: add column household_id (BIGINT) with FK to consumer.household.household_id - addresses should link to households, not just individual shoppers

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer/shopper profile this address belongs to. Links the address record to the master consumer party in the CRM and DTC systems.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address record. Active addresses are eligible for order fulfillment and marketing. Inactive addresses are retained for historical reporting. Deleted status supports GDPR right-to-erasure soft-delete workflows.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); CCPA Section 1798.105; SAP S/4HANA Customer Master Status

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the address by its business purpose. Billing addresses are used for invoicing and financial compliance; shipping addresses drive DTC order fulfillment and last-mile logistics; home and work addresses support personalized marketing and consumer segmentation.
attributes.references: GS1 Party Address Type Standard; SAP S/4HANA SD Address Category

attributes.name: carrier_route
attributes.description: USPS carrier route code assigned to this address (e.g., C001, R001, B001, H001). Used for direct mail presort discounts, delivery sequence optimization, and postal cost modeling in consumer marketing programs.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Carrier Route Certification; USPS Publication 28

attributes.name: census_tract
attributes.description: U.S. Census Bureau census tract code for the address location. Enables demographic overlay analysis, market penetration reporting by socioeconomic segment, and trade area planning for consumer goods distribution.
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line; Nielsen IQ Market Intelligence - Geographic Segmentation

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the consumer's address. Used for geographic segmentation, regional marketing campaigns, distribution zone assignment, and regulatory data residency tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; UPU S42 Address Standard

attributes.name: consent_captured
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit consumer consent was obtained for storing and processing this address record under applicable privacy regulations (GDPR/CCPA). True indicates consent is on file; False requires consent collection before marketing use.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawfulness of Processing); GDPR Article 7 (Conditions for Consent); CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the consumer provided consent for storage and processing of this address record. Required for GDPR Article 7 compliance documentation and CCPA opt-in audit trails.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the consumer's address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Drives GDPR/CCPA data residency compliance, international shipping eligibility, tax jurisdiction, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 44 (Data Transfers); CCPA Section 1798.140; GS1 Country Code Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this address record was first created in the system. Supports GDPR Article 30 records of processing activities, data lineage tracking, and audit trail requirements for consumer data governance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing); ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Logging; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: data_residency_region
attributes.description: Geographic data residency classification for this address record, indicating the regulatory jurisdiction governing data storage and processing. Drives GDPR (EU), CCPA (US/CA), and other regional privacy law compliance for data localization requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 44-49 (International Data Transfers); CCPA Section 1798.140; ISO/IEC 27001 Data Residency

attributes.name: deliverability_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00–100.00) representing the likelihood that a physical shipment or direct mail piece will be successfully delivered to this address. Derived from address validation provider output. Supports carrier selection and DTC fulfillment risk management.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Deliverability Standards; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: dma_code
attributes.description: Nielsen Designated Market Area (DMA) code for the address location. Used for media planning, Share of Voice (SOV) analysis, and regional brand marketing investment allocation in consumer goods trade promotion programs.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ DMA Definitions; Nielsen Retail Measurement Service

attributes.name: do_not_mail
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has opted out of physical direct mail marketing to this address. When True, this address must be suppressed from direct mail campaign execution lists. Supports GDPR right-to-object and CCPA opt-out compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21 (Right to Object); CCPA Section 1798.120; FTC CAN-SPAM Act; DMA (Data & Marketing Association) Guidelines

attributes.name: dpv_confirmation
attributes.description: USPS Delivery Point Validation confirmation code indicating the deliverability of the address. Y=Confirmed deliverable, S=Confirmed deliverable (secondary info missing), D=Confirmed deliverable (secondary info present but unneeded), N=Not confirmed. Critical for DTC fulfillment and direct mail campaigns.
attributes.references: USPS CASS DPV Certification; USPS Publication 28 - Postal Addressing Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this address record is considered valid and active for business use. Supports bi-temporal data modeling, address history tracking, and GDPR right-to-erasure compliance by enabling point-in-time address reconstruction.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy); ISO 8601 Date Standard; SAP S/4HANA Address Validity Period

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which this address record is no longer valid for business use. Null indicates an open-ended active address. Used for address lifecycle management, historical reporting, and GDPR data minimization compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Storage Limitation); ISO 8601 Date Standard; SAP S/4HANA Address Validity Period

attributes.name: format_type
attributes.description: Classification of the address format to guide formatting, validation, and carrier routing logic. PO Box addresses may not be eligible for certain DTC carriers; military addresses (APO/FPO/DPO) require specific handling; rural route addresses may have extended delivery windows.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 - Postal Addressing Standards; UPU S42 International Address Standard

attributes.name: geocoding_accuracy
attributes.description: Precision level of the geocoded latitude/longitude coordinates for this address. Rooftop indicates exact parcel-level geocoding; range_interpolated indicates interpolation between street numbers; geometric_center indicates centroid of a polygon. Impacts reliability of proximity-based analytics.
attributes.references: Google Maps Geocoding API Accuracy Levels; ISO 19111 Geographic Coordinate Reference Systems

attributes.name: is_default_billing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the consumer's default billing address for payment processing and invoice generation. Used in DTC checkout flows and financial compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Customer Master Billing Address; PCI DSS Requirement 3

attributes.name: is_default_shipping
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the consumer's default shipping destination for DTC orders. Distinct from is_primary as a consumer may have a primary home address but a different default shipping address (e.g., workplace).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Partner Address Determination; Oracle Cloud Order Management

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the consumer's primary address record for the given address type. When True, this address is used as the default for order fulfillment, marketing communications, and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Address Management

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the consumer's address in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Enables geocoded proximity analysis, delivery zone optimization, and location-based personalized marketing.
attributes.references: WGS84 Geodetic Datum; ISO 6709 Geographic Point Location

attributes.name: line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including house/building number and street name. Core component of the consumer's physical location used for DTC order fulfillment, direct mail marketing, and GDPR/CCPA data residency compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; USPS Postal Addressing Standards; GS1 GLN Address Standard

attributes.name: line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, unit, floor, or building designations. Supplements address_line_1 to ensure complete and accurate delivery routing for DTC shipments.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; USPS Postal Addressing Standards

attributes.name: line_3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line for additional location details such as neighborhood, district, or care-of designations. Used in international address formats where three address lines are required.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 International Postal Address Components

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the consumer's address in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used alongside latitude for geocoded proximity analysis, store locator features, and last-mile delivery optimization.
attributes.references: WGS84 Geodetic Datum; ISO 6709 Geographic Point Location

attributes.name: plus4_code
attributes.description: The four-digit USPS ZIP+4 extension code that narrows delivery to a specific block face or building. Enables postal presort discounts for direct mail campaigns and improves delivery precision for DTC shipments within the United States.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP+4 Code Standard; USPS Publication 28; USPS CASS Certification

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code of the consumer's address. Used for last-mile delivery routing, trade area analysis, demographic segmentation, and carrier rate determination in DTC fulfillment.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP Code Standard; UPU S42; GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: residential_indicator
attributes.description: Classification of the address as residential or commercial. Impacts carrier surcharge calculations (UPS/FedEx residential delivery fees), marketing segmentation, and DTC fulfillment cost modeling.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Residential Delivery Indicator; UPS/FedEx Residential Surcharge Guidelines

attributes.name: sales_territory_code
attributes.description: Internal sales territory or region code assigned to this address based on geographic boundaries. Used for Sales Force Automation (SFA) territory assignment, trade promotion planning, and regional sales performance reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Territory Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Territory

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: The originating channel or system through which this address was captured. Supports data lineage, source quality scoring, and GDPR/CCPA consent audit trails. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: crm|dtc_checkout|loyalty_enrollment|call_center|mobile_app|web_portal|third_party|manual_entry — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing); CCPA Section 1798.100; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating operational system of record (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Contact Address ID, SAP S/4HANA Business Partner Address GUID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA BP Address GUID; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Address Object; Oracle Cloud ERP Party Site ID

attributes.name: source_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this address record originated. Supports data lineage, master data management (MDM) conflict resolution, and Silver Layer data quality governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Oracle Cloud ERP; ISO/IEC 27001 Asset Management

attributes.name: standardized_address
