attributes.description: The full address formatted as a single standardized string per USPS/UPU postal standards after address validation and normalization (e.g., '123 MAIN ST APT 4B, CHICAGO IL 60601-1234'). Used as the canonical address for carrier label generation and deduplication.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Standardization; UPU S42; GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy)

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the consumer's address using ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes (e.g., US-CA, CA-ON). Supports tax jurisdiction determination, regional compliance, and territory-based sales reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2 Country Subdivision Codes; GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Used for scheduling personalized marketing communications at optimal local times and for regulatory compliance with time-sensitive consumer notifications.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; GDPR Article 12 (Timely Communication)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this address record was last modified. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline, data freshness monitoring, and GDPR data accuracy compliance tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy); ISO/IEC 27001 Change Management; SAP S/4HANA Change Document

attributes.name: validation_provider
attributes.description: Name of the third-party address validation service used to verify this address (e.g., USPS CASS, SmartyStreets, Loqate, Google Maps API). Supports audit trails for data quality governance and vendor performance tracking.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification; ISO 9001 Data Quality Management

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current validation state of the address record as determined by address verification services (e.g., USPS CASS, SmartyStreets, Loqate). Validated addresses reduce failed DTC deliveries and return-to-sender costs. Failed addresses require consumer outreach before order fulfillment.
attributes.references: USPS CASS (Coding Accuracy Support System); GS1 Address Validation Guidelines

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the address was last validated by the address verification service. Used to determine if re-validation is needed based on data freshness policies and to support data quality SLA reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; USPS CASS Certification Requirements

products.name: loyalty_account
products.description: Loyalty program membership account and transaction history for a consumer enrolled in a CPG brand loyalty or rewards program. Captures account master (program name, membership tier, enrollment date, points balance, lifetime points earned/redeemed, tier qualification spend, tier review date, status) and individual points movement events (earn, redeem, adjust, expire — with points amount, triggering event, associated order reference, balance snapshot, processing status, timestamp). Supports CLTV calculation, personalized promotions, consumer retention programs, and points liability reporting required by finance.

attributes.name: loyalty_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the loyalty program account record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: consent_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consumer.consent_record. Business justification: loyalty_account stores consent_data_sharing, consent_marketing, and consent_timestamp as denormalized operational flags. The consent_record table is the formal GDPR/CCPA consent repository. Adding con

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program definition under which this account was created (e.g., brand-specific rewards program, coalition program).
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud – Trade Promotion / Account Management

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consumer.loyalty_tier. Business justification: loyalty_account.membership_tier is a denormalized STRING storing the current tier name. The loyalty_tier table is the authoritative reference for tier definitions (tier_name, tier_code, tier_rank, req

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.pos_transaction. Business justification: Tracks which POS transactions generated loyalty points for accounting liability, member statements, and retailer reconciliation. Essential for consumer goods brands operating loyalty programs across t

attributes.name: referral_account_loyalty_account_id
attributes.description: Loyalty account ID of the existing member who referred this consumer to the program. Used for referral reward attribution, viral growth tracking, and network-effect analysis in consumer retention programs.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; CPG loyalty referral program standards

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer's preferred or most frequently visited retail store location. Used for store-level loyalty analytics, On Shelf Availability (OSA) correlation, and localized promotion targeting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud – Retail Execution; TradeEdge Channel Visibility

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer profile who owns this loyalty account. Links to the consumer master record in the Consumer domain.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable membership number assigned to the consumer at enrollment. Printed on loyalty cards, referenced in consumer communications, and used for in-store identification. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the loyalty account. 'active' = fully operational; 'suspended' = temporarily restricted (e.g., fraud review); 'closed' = permanently deactivated; 'pending' = enrollment not yet confirmed; 'frozen' = points locked pending investigation. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GDPR Article 17 (right to erasure)

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the loyalty account indicating whether it belongs to an individual consumer, a household unit, a small business buyer, or a coalition partner program. Drives eligibility rules and benefit structures.

attributes.name: cltv_segment
attributes.description: Consumer's current Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) segment classification derived from purchase history, points activity, and predictive modeling. Used for personalized promotion targeting, retention investment prioritization, and Trade Promotion Optimization (TPO). Not a calculated metric — this is a segment label assigned by the analytics/ML pipeline.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud – CRM; SAP IBP Demand Planning; CPG CLTV analytics

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: Consumer's preferred channel for receiving loyalty program communications (e.g., points balance updates, tier change notifications, promotional offers). Drives outbound communication channel selection in CRM and marketing automation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud – CRM

attributes.name: consent_data_sharing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has consented to sharing their loyalty data with third-party partners (e.g., retail partners, coalition program members). Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance. True = consented; False = not consented.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 28 (Data Processor); CCPA Section 1798.115

attributes.name: consent_marketing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has provided explicit opt-in consent to receive marketing communications related to the loyalty program. Required for GDPR Article 6 lawful basis and CCPA compliance. True = consented; False = not consented.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis); GDPR Article 7 (Consent); CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp at which the consumer's most recent consent preferences were captured or last updated. Required for GDPR audit trail demonstrating when consent was obtained. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code representing the country in which the loyalty account is registered. Determines applicable regulatory framework (GDPR, CCPA, etc.), program rules, and currency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp at which this loyalty account record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the consumer enrolled in the loyalty program (e.g., web, mobile app, in-store, call center, partner, Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) platform). Used for channel attribution and acquisition cost analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud – Retail Execution; DTC channel standards

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the consumer formally enrolled in the loyalty program. Used to calculate membership tenure, anniversary rewards, and cohort-based retention analytics. Serves as EFFECTIVE_FROM for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GDPR Article 7 (consent records)

attributes.name: enrollment_source_code
attributes.description: Campaign or promotion source code associated with the consumer's enrollment event (e.g., a Trade Promotion Management (TPM) campaign code, QR code identifier, or referral code). Used for acquisition attribution and Trade Promotion Optimization (TPO) ROI analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud – Trade Promotion Management (TPM); SAP IBP

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the loyalty account is scheduled to expire or become inactive if no qualifying activity occurs. Nullable for open-ended programs. Serves as EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity. Used for points liability forecasting and consumer re-engagement campaigns.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; FTC Advertising and Labeling guidelines

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this loyalty account has been flagged for suspected fraudulent activity (e.g., points manipulation, account takeover, synthetic identity). True = flagged for review; False = no fraud concern. Triggers account suspension workflow.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising and Labeling; CPSC; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: fraud_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent fraud review was conducted or scheduled for this account. Nullable if no fraud review has occurred. Used by the fraud operations team to track investigation timelines.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) representing the consumer's preferred language for loyalty program communications (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'es-MX'). Supports multilingual global loyalty programs.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent qualifying activity (purchase, redemption, or engagement event) on this loyalty account. Used to determine account dormancy, trigger re-engagement campaigns, and apply activity-based points expiry policies.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; CPG consumer retention analytics

attributes.name: last_earn_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent points earn event on this account. Used to assess earn recency for RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) segmentation and to trigger earn-reminder communications.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; CPG CLTV analytics

attributes.name: last_redemption_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent points redemption event on this account. Used to assess redemption engagement, identify high-value redeemers, and support personalized redemption offer targeting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; CPG consumer engagement analytics

attributes.name: lifetime_points_earned
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all points ever earned on this account since enrollment, including base earn, bonus earn, and promotional earn events. Never decremented by redemptions or expirations. Used for Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) calculation and tier qualification history.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; CPG CLTV analytics standards

attributes.name: lifetime_points_expired
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all points that have expired on this account due to inactivity or program rules. Used for points liability release reporting in finance and consumer re-engagement analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: lifetime_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all points ever redeemed on this account since enrollment. Used for redemption rate analysis, points liability reconciliation, and CLTV modeling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey response from this consumer (0–10 scale). Used to segment consumers into Promoters (9–10), Passives (7–8), and Detractors (0–6) for loyalty program health monitoring and consumer engagement strategy.
attributes.references: NPS methodology (Bain & Company); Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud – CRM

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent NPS survey response was captured for this consumer. Used to assess NPS data freshness and schedule next survey cadence.
attributes.references: NPS methodology; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: opt_out_date
attributes.description: Date on which the consumer formally opted out of the loyalty program or withdrew consent for data processing. Nullable if the consumer has not opted out. Required for GDPR right-to-erasure and CCPA opt-out compliance tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: points_balance
attributes.description: Current redeemable points balance on the loyalty account as of the last transaction processing. Represents the net of all earned, redeemed, adjusted, and expired points. Used for consumer-facing balance display and finance points liability reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (Financial Accounting); Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: points_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the monetary currency in which tier_qualification_spend and redemption values are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency global loyalty programs.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: points_expiry_policy
attributes.description: Policy governing when unredeemed points on this account expire. Options include rolling 12-month inactivity, annual calendar expiry, never-expire, program-end expiry, or activity-based reset. Drives points liability forecasting and consumer communication triggers.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising and Labeling; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: preferred_redemption_type
attributes.description: Consumer's stated or inferred preferred method of redeeming loyalty points. Used for personalized redemption offer targeting and program design optimization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: discount|free_product|gift_card|charity|cashback|experience|travel|merchandise — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud – Trade Promotion; CPG personalization best practices

attributes.name: previous_tier
attributes.description: The membership tier held by the consumer immediately before the most recent tier change. Used for tier transition analysis, win-back campaigns, and understanding tier migration patterns.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; CPG loyalty analytics

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this loyalty account record originated (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud (SFCGC), SAP S/4HANA). Used for data lineage tracking and Silver Layer reconciliation in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer data lineage standards; SAP S/4HANA; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: tier_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current membership tier became effective. Used to calculate tier tenure, assess tier stability, and trigger tier-anniversary benefits.

attributes.name: tier_qualification_spend
attributes.description: Cumulative qualifying purchase spend (in program currency) accumulated within the current tier review period. Compared against tier thresholds to determine tier upgrade, maintenance, or downgrade at the next tier review date.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud – Trade Promotion; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: tier_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date on which the consumer's membership tier will be evaluated against tier_qualification_spend thresholds for potential upgrade, maintenance, or downgrade. Drives proactive consumer engagement campaigns before review.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; CPG loyalty program management best practices

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp at which this loyalty account record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SOX; ISO 9001; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer CDC standards

products.name: loyalty_transaction
products.description: Individual points movement event within a loyalty account — earn, redeem, adjust, or expire. Records points amount, triggering event (purchase, referral, review, birthday bonus, promotion), associated order reference, balance snapshot (before/after), processing status, and transaction timestamp. Provides the complete audit trail for loyalty currency reconciliation and supports points liability reporting required by finance.

attributes.name: loyalty_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for each loyalty points movement event. Serves as the primary key for the loyalty_transaction data product and enables precise audit trail reconciliation of all points currency activity.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Trade Promotion Management (TPM) promotion or loyalty campaign that triggered a bonus points award. Null when the transaction is not promotion-driven.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Trade Promotion Management (TPM); SAP IBP Demand Planning

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Required for accounting loyalty point expense; loyalty_transaction must post expense to a GL account for financial statements.

attributes.name: loyalty_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program account against which this points movement is recorded. Links the transaction to the member's running balance and tier status.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Management Module

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific loyalty program under which this transaction was recorded. Supports enterprises operating multiple loyalty programs (e.g., brand-specific, retailer co-branded, DTC) with separate earn/redeem rules.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Program Configuration

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program tier (e.g., Silver, Gold, Platinum) that was active on the consumer's account at the time of this transaction. Tier determines earn rate multipliers and redemption eligibility.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Tier Management

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order or DTC purchase that triggered an earn or redemption event. Null for non-purchase-triggered transactions such as birthday bonuses, referral awards, or manual adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Order; GS1 Order Management Standards

attributes.name: pos_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.pos_transaction. Business justification: Links loyalty earn/redeem events to originating retail purchase for audit trail, dispute resolution, and reconciliation between retailer POS feeds and brand loyalty system. Required for financial cont

attributes.name: reversal_reference_loyalty_transaction_id
attributes.description: For reversal-type transactions, the loyalty_transaction_id of the original transaction being reversed. Enables bidirectional audit trail linking between original and reversal entries for points reconciliation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Reversal Management

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the end consumer or shopper who owns the loyalty account. Supports GDPR/CCPA data subject requests and consumer-level analytics across the CRM platform.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.100; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consumer Profile

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) purchased or redeemed in this transaction. Populated for purchase-triggered earn events and product-reward redemptions. Enables product-level loyalty attribution and NPD performance analysis.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Material Master

attributes.name: trade_promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.trade_promotion. Business justification: Loyalty programs need to measure ROI and point liability across entire trade promotion campaigns (which span multiple events). Enables campaign-level loyalty performance reporting, point accrual forec

attributes.name: adjustment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative entered by a customer service agent or system process explaining the rationale for a manual points adjustment or reversal. Supports audit review and consumer dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Case Management

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for manual point adjustments or reversals (e.g., GOODWILL, DATA_CORRECTION, FRAUD_REVERSAL, SYSTEM_ERROR, PROMOTION_CORRECTION). Populated only for adjust and reversal transaction types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GOODWILL|DATA_CORRECTION|FRAUD_REVERSAL|SYSTEM_ERROR|PROMOTION_CORRECTION|COMPLAINT_RESOLUTION — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Adjustment Codes; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: bonus_multiplier
attributes.description: The multiplier applied to the base earn rate for bonus transactions (e.g., 2.0 for double points, 1.5 for 50% bonus). Null for non-bonus transactions. Used to decompose total points awarded into base and bonus components for TPM ROI analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Earn Rate; Trade Promotion Management (TPM) ROI

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The consumer engagement channel through which the triggering event occurred: ecommerce (third-party online), mobile_app (brand app), retail_store (physical POS), dtc_website (Direct-to-Consumer website), call_centre (agent-assisted), or kiosk (in-store self-service). Supports omnichannel loyalty analytics and channel attribution reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Channel Management; Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement

attributes.name: consent_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer's active consent for loyalty program participation and data processing was verified at the time of this transaction. Supports GDPR Article 7 and CCPA consent audit requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 — Conditions for Consent; CCPA Section 1798.120; ISO 27001 Data Privacy

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the market in which this loyalty transaction occurred (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Supports multi-market loyalty program reporting, regulatory compliance (GDPR for EU markets), and geographic performance analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; GDPR Article 3 — Territorial Scope; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this loyalty transaction record was first created in the source system. Serves as the system audit creation timestamp for data lineage, reconciliation, and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the monetary_value field (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency loyalty programs operating across international markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: data_retention_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction record is subject to a data retention hold, preventing deletion or anonymization beyond the standard retention period. Set to True for records under legal hold, active fraud investigation, or regulatory audit. Supports GDPR right-to-erasure compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 — Right to Erasure; CCPA Section 1798.105; SOX Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: earn_rate
attributes.description: The points-per-currency-unit rate applied to calculate the points_amount for earn transactions (e.g., 1.5 points per USD spent). Captures the rate in effect at the time of the transaction for historical accuracy and program performance analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Earn Rate Configuration

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction has been flagged by the fraud detection system as potentially fraudulent or suspicious. Flagged transactions are held for review before points are posted. Supports loyalty program integrity and financial controls.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising and Labeling Guidelines; SOX Internal Controls; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Fraud Management

attributes.name: fraud_review_status
attributes.description: The outcome of the fraud review process for transactions flagged by the fraud detection system: not_reviewed (default), under_review (investigation in progress), cleared (confirmed legitimate), or confirmed_fraud (fraudulent transaction confirmed and reversed).
attributes.references: FTC Guidelines; SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Fraud Case Management

attributes.name: is_bonus_transaction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this earn transaction includes a bonus points multiplier applied on top of the base earn rate (e.g., double-points promotion, birthday bonus, new member bonus). Enables separation of base earn from promotional bonus in program cost analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Bonus Configuration; Trade Promotion Management (TPM)

attributes.name: monetary_value
attributes.description: The monetary equivalent value of the points moved in this transaction, expressed in the program's base currency. Used for points liability valuation on the balance sheet and for calculating the cost of loyalty rewards in COGS reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Financial Reporting; GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials

attributes.name: points_amount
attributes.description: The absolute number of loyalty points moved in this transaction. Always stored as a positive value regardless of direction; the transaction_type field determines whether points are added or subtracted from the account balance. Supports fractional points for precision in tiered earn-rate calculations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Points Engine; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: points_balance_after
attributes.description: Snapshot of the loyalty account's total available points balance immediately after this transaction was applied. Together with points_balance_before, provides the complete before/after audit trail for each points movement event.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Balance Snapshot

attributes.name: points_balance_before
attributes.description: Snapshot of the loyalty account's total available points balance immediately before this transaction was applied. Critical for audit trail completeness and points liability reconciliation required by finance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Balance Snapshot

attributes.name: points_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the points_amount increases (credit) or decreases (debit) the loyalty account balance. Enables double-entry-style reconciliation of the points ledger for finance liability reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Financial Ledger Integrity; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Ledger

attributes.name: points_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the points awarded in this earn transaction are scheduled to expire per the loyalty program's currency expiration policy. Null for non-earn transactions. Drives the points liability aging schedule reported to finance.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Expiration Policy; SOX Points Liability Reporting

attributes.name: points_liability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction contributes to the outstanding points liability on the company's balance sheet (True for unspent earned points, False for redeemed or expired points). Supports finance's points liability reserve calculation under GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials — Deferred Revenue

attributes.name: processing_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the loyalty transaction was processed and posted to the account balance by the loyalty engine. May differ from transaction_timestamp due to batch processing windows or pending verification holds.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Processing Engine; SOX Audit Trail

attributes.name: program_year
attributes.description: The fiscal or calendar year of the loyalty program in which this transaction occurred. Used for annual points balance resets, year-over-year program performance reporting, and points expiration policy enforcement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Program Year Configuration; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials — Fiscal Calendar

attributes.name: qualifying_spend_amount
attributes.description: The net purchase amount (after discounts, excluding taxes) on the triggering order that qualified for points earning. Used to verify earn rate calculations and supports COGS and loyalty cost-per-transaction reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Net Order Value; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: redemption_value
attributes.description: The monetary discount or reward value applied to the consumer's order when points are redeemed. Populated only for redeem-type transactions. Used to calculate the effective discount rate and redemption liability release in financial reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Redemption

attributes.name: source_transaction_ref
attributes.description: The native transaction identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce record ID, SAP document number, POS receipt number). Enables cross-system reconciliation and traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Transaction Reference; SAP S/4HANA SD Document Number

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable business identifier for the loyalty transaction, formatted as LT-{YYYY}-{sequence}. Used in consumer-facing communications, call-centre lookups, and points dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Transaction Reference; GS1 Identification Standards

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the loyalty transaction reflecting its processing lifecycle: pending (awaiting confirmation), processed (successfully posted to account), reversed (cancelled after posting), failed (processing error), or cancelled (voided before posting).
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Transaction Lifecycle; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the loyalty points movement event occurred in the real world — i.e., when the triggering business event (purchase, referral, etc.) was confirmed and points were posted. This is the principal business event timestamp, distinct from system audit timestamps.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Event Timestamp; ISO 8601 Date/Time Standard

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Categorical discriminator identifying the nature of the points movement: earn (points awarded), redeem (points consumed), adjust (manual correction), expire (points lapsed per program rules), transfer (inter-account movement), or reversal (cancellation of a prior transaction). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: earn|redeem|adjust|expire|transfer|reversal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Management; ISO 8583 Financial Transaction Message Standard

attributes.name: trigger_event
attributes.description: The specific business event that initiated this points movement, such as purchase, referral, product_review, birthday_bonus, promotion_bonus, account_registration, social_share, or survey_completion. Drives attribution analysis and program ROI reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: purchase|referral|product_review|birthday_bonus|promotion_bonus|account_registration|social_share|survey_completion — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Event Configuration; FTC Advertising and Labeling Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this loyalty transaction record was last modified in the source system. Tracks reversals, status changes, and manual adjustments for audit and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

products.name: preference
products.description: Unified consumer preference profile capturing product, brand, channel, and communication preferences. Stores preference category (product category, brand, flavor, fragrance, pack size, channel, communication channel, contact frequency, preferred time of day, preferred language), preference value, opt-in/opt-out status, preference source (declared via web/app/call-center vs. inferred by ML model), confidence level, effective date, brand-level overrides, and last updated timestamp. Drives personalization engines, recommendation systems, communication orchestration, and targeted consumer engagement programs for CPG brands. This is the SSOT for all consumer preference data — both product/brand preferences and communication/contact preferences.

attributes.name: preference_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each consumer preference record in the Consumer Goods lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for the preference data product.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_brand. Business justification: Brand affinity tracking and brand equity reporting require linking shopper preferences to the brand master. Consumer insights teams run brand preference segmentation and NPS-by-brand reports. brand_ov

attributes.name: consent_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal consent record that authorizes the collection and use of this preference. Links to the consent management system to ensure every preference is backed by a valid, auditable consent event as required by GDPR and CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.100; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consent Management

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Reference to the household entity this consumer belongs to, enabling household-level preference aggregation for CPG targeting and personalization programs.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel — Household Identifier

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program membership associated with this preference record, used to align preferences with loyalty tier benefits and targeted offers.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Management

attributes.name: product_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_category. Business justification: Consumer category-level preference analytics and personalization engines require linking shopper preferences to the product category master. Category managers use this for targeted marketing by catego

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer profile who owns this preference record. Links to the consumer master in the CRM/DTC system (Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud).
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consumer Profile Object

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Links consumer packaging preferences to specific packaging profiles to guide sustainable packaging design decisions.

attributes.name: brand_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference record has been overridden at the brand level, superseding the consumer's global preference. When True, the brand_id field identifies which brand applied the override. Enables brand-specific preference management within a multi-brand CPG portfolio.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Brand Preference Management

attributes.name: brand_override_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for the brand-level preference override when brand_override_flag is True. Used for audit trails and compliance reporting, particularly for regulatory restrictions (e.g., FDA, CPSC product safety communications).
attributes.references: FDA Regulatory Compliance; CPSC Consumer Safety Notifications

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the preference type. Defines what dimension of consumer behavior or communication this preference record governs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: product_category|brand|flavor_fragrance|pack_size|channel|communication_channel|contact_frequency|preferred_time_of_day|preferred_language — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consumer Preference Framework

attributes.name: cltv_tier
attributes.description: The consumer's CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) tier at the time this preference was recorded. Enables preference prioritization and investment decisions — high-CLTV consumers may receive more personalized preference-driven experiences and premium engagement programs.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — CLTV Segmentation; Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel

attributes.name: confidence_score
attributes.description: Numeric confidence level (0.0000 to 1.0000) assigned to this preference record, particularly relevant for ML-inferred preferences. A score of 1.0 indicates absolute certainty (typically for declared preferences); lower scores indicate inferred preferences with varying degrees of model confidence. Used by recommendation systems to weight preference signals.
attributes.references: CPG AI/ML Personalization Standards; Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel Analytics

attributes.name: consent_basis
attributes.description: The GDPR lawful basis under which this preference data is collected and processed. 'explicit_consent' is the most common basis for CPG consumer preference programs. Required for GDPR Article 6 compliance documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when this preference record was first captured in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp and is used for GDPR consent audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: data_subject_request_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference record is subject to an active Data Subject Request (DSR) under GDPR or CCPA (e.g., right to erasure, right to access, right to portability). When True, downstream systems must apply appropriate data handling restrictions.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this preference record becomes valid and actionable for personalization, communication orchestration, and recommendation systems. Aligns with GDPR consent effective date requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consent Management

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which this preference record is no longer valid. Nullable for open-ended preferences. Used to enforce time-bound consent periods and seasonal preference windows. When expired, preference_status transitions to 'expired'.

attributes.name: flavor_fragrance_preference
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred flavor (for food/beverage/oral care) or fragrance (for personal care/household products). Drives variant-level recommendations and new product development (NPD) consumer insights. Aligns with INCI nomenclature for fragrance ingredients.
attributes.references: INCI — International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients; IFRA Standards

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the geographic jurisdiction in which this preference is valid. Enables country-specific preference management for global CPG brands operating under different regulatory frameworks (e.g., GDPR in EU, CCPA in USA).

attributes.name: inference_basis
attributes.description: The data signal or behavioral evidence used to infer this preference when preference_source is ML-inferred. Provides transparency into the inference methodology for model explainability and GDPR Article 22 automated decision-making compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 22 — Automated Decision-Making; Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel

attributes.name: inference_model_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the ML model used to infer this preference when preference_source is 'inferred_ml' or 'inferred_purchase_history'. Enables model governance, A/B testing of recommendation algorithms, and reproducibility of inferred preferences for audit purposes.
attributes.references: CPG AI/ML Model Governance Standards; ISO 9001 — Quality Management

attributes.name: is_global_preference
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference applies globally across all brands in the CPG portfolio (True) or is specific to a single brand identified by brand_id (False). Global preferences serve as the default when no brand-specific preference exists.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Multi-Brand Preference Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent update to this preference record, whether from a consumer-declared change, a system re-inference, or an administrative override. Critical for freshness scoring in personalization engines and GDPR audit trails.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context or qualifications about this preference record, such as special instructions captured during a call-center interaction or notes from a consumer survey. Used by CRM agents and consumer engagement teams.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consumer Notes

attributes.name: nps_segment
attributes.description: The consumer's NPS (Net Promoter Score) segment classification at the time this preference was captured. Used to contextualize preference data — promoters may have stronger brand preferences while detractors may have channel avoidance preferences. Supports consumer engagement strategy.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology — Bain & Company; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consumer Insights

attributes.name: opt_in_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has opted in (True) or opted out (False) for this specific preference category. Critical for GDPR/CCPA compliance — a False value means the consumer must NOT be targeted via this preference dimension.

attributes.name: pack_size_preference
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred pack size or format (e.g., 'travel_size', 'standard', 'family_size', 'bulk', 'subscription_bundle'). Used to tailor product recommendations and promotional offers to the consumer's typical purchase behavior.
attributes.references: GS1 GTIN Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM — Packaging Hierarchy

attributes.name: preference_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the preference record. 'active' means the preference is valid and in use by personalization engines; 'suppressed' means the preference is overridden by a brand-level or regulatory rule; 'expired' means the preference has passed its effective end date.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Preference Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: preferred_channel
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred channel for receiving brand communications, promotions, and personalized content. Drives communication orchestration in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud and DTC engagement programs. 'none' indicates the consumer has opted out of all outbound communications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: email|sms|push_notification|direct_mail|in_app|whatsapp|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Communication Orchestration; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: preferred_contact_frequency
attributes.description: The consumer's declared preference for how often they wish to receive brand communications. Used by communication orchestration engines to enforce contact frequency caps and prevent consumer fatigue in CPG engagement programs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|bi_weekly|monthly|quarterly|as_needed|never — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Contact Frequency Management; FTC CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred language for communications, expressed as an IETF BCP 47 language tag (e.g., 'en-US', 'fr-FR', 'es-MX'). Used by communication orchestration platforms to deliver brand content in the consumer's preferred language.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47 — Language Tags; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Communication Preferences

attributes.name: preferred_time_of_day
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred time window for receiving communications and push notifications. Used by send-time optimization algorithms in CPG personalization engines to maximize open rates and engagement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Send-Time Optimization

attributes.name: preferred_timezone
attributes.description: The IANA timezone identifier for the consumer's preferred timezone (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Used in conjunction with preferred_time_of_day to schedule communications at the correct local time for global CPG consumer bases.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Communication Scheduling

attributes.name: rank
attributes.description: Ordinal ranking of this preference value relative to other values within the same category for the same consumer. Rank 1 indicates the most preferred option. Enables ranked preference lists for recommendation engines (e.g., first, second, third flavor choice).

attributes.name: retail_channel_preference
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred retail channel for purchasing CPG products. Used for channel-specific targeting, trade promotion alignment, and omnichannel engagement strategies. Supports DSD (Direct Store Delivery) and DTC channel optimization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ecommerce|grocery|mass_retail|pharmacy|dtc|club_store|convenience|specialty — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Channel Management; TradeEdge Channel Visibility

attributes.name: sku_preference
attributes.description: The specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) code that the consumer has declared or demonstrated a preference for. Enables SKU-level personalization and targeted replenishment reminders in DTC and e-commerce channels. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA MM material master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master; GS1 SKU Standards

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Origin of the preference record indicating whether it was explicitly declared by the consumer through a digital or physical touchpoint, or inferred by an ML model or behavioral analysis. Declared preferences carry higher trust weight in personalization engines. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: declared_web|declared_app|declared_call_center|declared_in_store|inferred_ml|inferred_purchase_history|inferred_survey — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Preference Capture; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: source_system_preference_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this preference record in the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud preference record ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and EDI-based data exchange between CPG operational systems.
attributes.references: EDI Standards; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Data Integration

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Granular sub-classification within the preference category. For example, within 'product_category' the subcategory may be 'hair_care' or 'oral_care'; within 'communication_channel' it may be 'email' or 'push_notification'. Enables multi-level preference taxonomy for CPG personalization engines.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consumer Preference Framework

attributes.name: suppression_reason
attributes.description: The reason this preference record has been suppressed when preference_status = 'suppressed'. Critical for GDPR right-to-erasure (Article 17) and CCPA opt-out compliance documentation. Ensures downstream systems do not act on suppressed preferences.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 — Right to Erasure; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The specific declared or inferred preference value within the category and subcategory. Examples: 'mint' for flavor, 'English' for language, 'morning' for time of day, 'weekly' for contact frequency, 'email' for communication channel. Free-form string to accommodate diverse CPG preference dimensions.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consumer Preference Framework

products.name: consent_record
products.description: Formal consent and privacy preference record for a consumer capturing GDPR, CCPA, and other regulatory consent obligations, including full audit history of all consent changes. Stores consent type (marketing email, SMS, push notification, data sharing, profiling, cookies), current consent status (granted, withdrawn, pending), consent version, capture method (web form, app, in-store, call center), capture timestamp, IP address, regulatory jurisdiction, expiry date, and immutable event log of every status change (prior status, new status, change trigger, channel, processing agent/system). This is the SSOT for consumer privacy compliance and provides the complete consent history required for GDPR Article 7 and CCPA compliance audits.

attributes.name: consent_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each consent record in the Consumer Goods consumer privacy system. Primary key for the consent_record data product, serving as the SSOT for GDPR Article 7 and CCPA compliance audits.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_brand. Business justification: GDPR/CCPA brand-level consent scoping requires consent records to reference the specific brand for which consent was granted. Privacy officers and DPOs must produce brand-level consent audit reports.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program associated with this consent record, if the consumer is a loyalty program member. Consent for loyalty program data processing is tracked separately from general marketing consent.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer profile record for whom this consent record applies. Links the consent record to the consumer master in the CRM/DTC system (Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud).

attributes.name: capture_method
attributes.description: Channel or mechanism through which the consumer's consent was captured. Identifies whether consent was obtained via a web form, mobile app, in-store interaction, call center agent, paper form, or email link. Required for GDPR proof-of-consent obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: capture_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time (with timezone offset) when the consumer's consent action was recorded in the system. This is the principal business event timestamp for the consent record and is immutable once set. Required for GDPR Article 7 audit trail.

attributes.name: change_trigger
attributes.description: The business reason or event that triggered the most recent change to the consent status. Distinguishes consumer-initiated changes from system-driven expirations, administrative overrides, legal requests (e.g., right to erasure), or re-consent campaigns.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3); GDPR Article 17; CCPA Section 1798.105; ISO 29101

attributes.name: consent_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) of the language in which the consent notice was presented to the consumer (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'es-MX'). Required to confirm consent was given in an intelligible form per GDPR Article 7.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(2); GDPR Recital 42; ISO 639-1; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: consent_proof_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL pointing to the stored proof-of-consent artifact (e.g., screenshot, signed form scan, call recording reference, Veeva Vault document ID). Supports GDPR Article 7(1) obligation to demonstrate that consent was given.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); Veeva Vault (Quality Documents); ISO 27001

attributes.name: consent_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of the consent grant — whether it applies globally across all Consumer Goods brands and products, is restricted to a specific brand, product category, or a single campaign. Enables granular consent management across the product portfolio.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 32; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consent record indicating whether the consumer has actively granted, withdrawn, or is pending confirmation of consent, or whether the consent has expired past its validity period.

attributes.name: consent_text_snapshot
attributes.description: Verbatim text or reference hash of the consent notice, privacy policy excerpt, or opt-in language presented to the consumer at the time of consent capture. Immutable record of what the consumer agreed to, required for GDPR Article 7 proof-of-consent.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Category of consent being captured, defining the specific processing activity for which the consumer has provided or withheld consent. Covers marketing email, SMS, push notification, data sharing, profiling, and cookies as required by GDPR and CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 22; CCPA Section 1798.120; ePrivacy Directive

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent notice, privacy policy, or terms document presented to the consumer at the time of consent capture. Enables tracking of which policy version was in effect when consent was given, critical for GDPR Article 7 compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: cookie_consent_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of cookie categories for which the consumer has granted consent (e.g., 'functional,analytics,marketing'). Captures granular cookie preferences as required by the ePrivacy Directive and GDPR for digital channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: necessary|functional|analytics|marketing|social_media|personalization|advertising — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ePrivacy Directive Article 5(3); GDPR Article 6; CCPA Section 1798.120; IAB TCF 2.0

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the consumer's country of residence at the time of consent capture. Determines applicable privacy regulation (e.g., GDPR for EU countries, CCPA for USA/California). Critical for multi-jurisdiction compliance management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this consent record was first created in the Consumer Goods data platform (Silver Layer). Distinct from capture_timestamp which records the business event time. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used by the consumer when providing consent in digital channels. Supports forensic audit trails and UX analysis of consent capture flows.

attributes.name: double_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer completed a double opt-in confirmation process (e.g., clicked a confirmation link in a verification email) in addition to the initial consent action. Double opt-in provides stronger proof of consent for marketing communications under GDPR.
attributes.references: GDPR Recital 32; GDPR Article 7; ePrivacy Directive Article 13

attributes.name: double_opt_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the consumer completed the double opt-in confirmation step. Null if double opt-in was not required or not yet completed. Provides the definitive timestamp for consent activation in double opt-in workflows.
attributes.references: GDPR Recital 32; GDPR Article 7; ePrivacy Directive Article 13

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this consent record is considered active and binding. Typically aligns with the capture date but may differ for backdated or scheduled consent activations. Supports MASTER_AGREEMENT role effective-period tracking.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this consent record expires and must be renewed or re-confirmed by the consumer. Null indicates open-ended consent with no defined expiry. Used to trigger consent renewal workflows and ensure ongoing compliance with GDPR's requirement for time-limited consent.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device from which the consumer submitted their consent. Captured for digital consent channels (web form, mobile app, email link) as evidence of consent origin. May be considered PII under GDPR in some EU jurisdictions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4(1); GDPR Recital 30; CCPA Section 1798.140(o)

attributes.name: is_current_record
attributes.description: Indicates whether this row represents the current active consent record for the consumer-consent_type combination. Supports Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD Type 2) pattern in the Silver Layer, where historical consent versions are retained for audit purposes and this flag identifies the latest version.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; ISO 29101; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer conventions

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: The lawful basis under GDPR Article 6 or equivalent regulation for processing the consumer's personal data. Consent is one of six legal bases; this field distinguishes consent-based processing from other lawful bases to support compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Recital 40-49; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: minor_age_threshold
attributes.description: Age threshold (in years) used to determine whether parental consent was required for this consent record, based on the applicable jurisdiction's rules (e.g., 16 for GDPR default, 13 for COPPA, 13-16 for EU member state variations). Null if consumer is not a minor.

attributes.name: parental_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether parental or guardian consent was obtained for a minor consumer. Required under GDPR Article 8 for children under 16 (or lower age threshold set by member state) and COPPA for US consumers under 13.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 8; COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: prior_consent_status
attributes.description: The consent status immediately before the most recent status change. Enables point-in-time audit reconstruction and supports the immutable event log requirement for GDPR Article 7 compliance audits without requiring a separate history table join.

attributes.name: processing_agent
attributes.description: Identifier of the system, application, or human agent (call center representative ID or system name) that processed and recorded the consent event. Supports accountability requirements under GDPR Article 5(2) and provides an audit trail of who or what captured the consent.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2); GDPR Article 24; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: profiling_consent_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Profiling and Automated Decision-Making Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has consented to automated profiling and decision-making activities, including personalization algorithms, NPS scoring, CLTV modeling, and segmentation. Required under GDPR Article 22 for automated decision-making with significant effects.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 22; GDPR Recital 71; CCPA Section 1798.120

tag_set.value: Profiling and Automated Decision-Making Consent Flag

attributes.name: re_consent_deadline
attributes.description: Date by which the consumer must re-confirm their consent before the current consent record is automatically withdrawn or expired. Null if re-consent is not required. Used to drive automated consent renewal campaigns.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: re_consent_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent record requires re-confirmation from the consumer due to a material change in the privacy policy, consent notice, or processing purpose. Triggers re-consent outreach workflows in the CRM system.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: record_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this consent record for the consumer-consent_type combination. Increments with each status change or update, enabling full audit history reconstruction. Version 1 is the initial consent capture; subsequent versions reflect changes.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The applicable privacy regulation or jurisdiction framework under which this consent record was created and must be managed. Determines the legal basis, retention rules, and consumer rights applicable to this record (e.g., GDPR for EU consumers, CCPA for California residents).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3; CCPA Section 1798.140(g); LGPD Article 3; ISO 29101

attributes.name: retention_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days this consent record must be retained for compliance purposes after the consent is withdrawn or expires. Determined by applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR Article 5(1)(e) storage limitation, CCPA). Drives automated data lifecycle management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e); GDPR Article 17; CCPA Section 1798.105; ISO 27001

attributes.name: third_party_sharing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has explicitly consented to their personal data being shared with third-party partners (e.g., retail partners, data brokers, analytics providers). Distinct from general data sharing consent; specifically governs external data transfers.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 44-49 (International Transfers); CCPA Section 1798.120; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this consent record in the data platform. Used for incremental data processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.

attributes.name: withdrawal_method
attributes.description: Channel or mechanism through which the consumer withdrew their consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. Required to demonstrate that withdrawal was as easy as giving consent per GDPR Article 7(3).

attributes.name: withdrawal_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the consumer withdrew their consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. GDPR Article 7(3) requires that withdrawal be as easy as giving consent; this timestamp documents the withdrawal event for audit purposes.

products.name: dtc_order
products.description: Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) order with line-item detail placed by a shopper through owned e-commerce or brand website channels. Captures order header (order number, date, status, channel, shipping/billing address, payment method, subtotal, discount, shipping cost, tax, total, currency, fulfillment reference) and line items (SKU/GTIN, product name, quantity ordered/shipped, unit price, line discount, line total, promotion code, fulfillment status, return flag). This is the SSOT for DTC channel order transactions and enables SKU-level purchase analysis, replenishment triggers, and product affinity modeling.
products.reference: DTC Order / SAP SD Sales Order

attributes.name: dtc_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) order record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Every DTC order must be assigned to a legal entity (company code) for statutory financial reporting, tax compliance, revenue recognition (ASC 606), and multi-entity consolidation. Consumer goods compa

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Order processing costs are allocated to internal cost centers for budgeting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
