attributes.description: Reference to the primary SKU enrolled in this subscription. Identifies the specific product variant (size, flavor, format) the consumer has subscribed to for auto-replenishment.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: acquisition_source
attributes.description: Marketing source or campaign that drove the consumer to subscribe (e.g., email campaign code, paid search, influencer referral, loyalty program). Used for marketing ROI (Return on Investment) attribution and SOV (Share of Voice) analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; FTC Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: auto_renew_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscription is configured to automatically renew at the end of each billing cycle (True) or requires explicit consumer action to continue (False). Governs recurring revenue recognition and consumer notification obligations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; FTC Negative Option Rule; GDPR Article 7 (consent)

attributes.name: billing_cycle_day
attributes.description: Day of the month (1–31) on which the subscription billing charge is processed. Governs the recurring payment schedule and aligns with the consumer's preferred billing date. Used in accounts receivable and DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud ERP - Financials; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the consumer formally cancelled the subscription. Distinct from end_date (which may be a future scheduled end). Used in churn cohort analysis and subscription tenure reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Consumer-stated or system-derived reason for cancelling the subscription. Populated when subscription_status transitions to 'cancelled'. Critical input for churn analysis, NPS (Net Promoter Score) correlation, and consumer retention strategy.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has exercised their CCPA right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal data associated with this subscription (True = opted out). Mandatory for California consumers. Drives data sharing restrictions downstream.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Sales channel through which the subscription was originally acquired (e.g., dtc_web, dtc_mobile). Supports DTC (Direct to Consumer) channel performance analysis, attribution reporting, and consumer acquisition cost tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; Nielsen IQ - Market Intelligence

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the subscription record was first created in the platform. Represents RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and subscription cohort analysis.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 30 (records of processing activities)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the subscription billing currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency DTC operations and financial consolidation reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Oracle Cloud ERP - Financials

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the subscription price per billing cycle, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1500 = 15%). Reflects subscriber loyalty pricing, promotional offers, or TPM (Trade Promotion Management) funded discounts.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Trade Promotion; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the subscription is scheduled to end or was terminated. Null for open-ended subscriptions. Represents EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for this agreement. Populated on cancellation or plan expiry.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: failed_payment_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of failed payment attempts on this subscription since inception. Used to trigger dunning workflows, payment retry logic, and subscription suspension rules. Key indicator for revenue leakage management.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud ERP - Financials; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which the subscription order is automatically triggered and fulfilled. Drives the replenishment schedule and next order date calculation. Key input for demand planning and S&OP forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP IBP - Demand Planning; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has provided explicit GDPR-compliant consent for data processing associated with this subscription (True) or not (False). Mandatory for EU consumers. Supports regulatory compliance and data governance audits.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 and Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: last_order_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the most recently fulfilled subscription order. Used to validate subscription activity, detect stalled subscriptions, and support FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory allocation for replenishment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: net_price
attributes.description: Actual amount charged to the consumer per billing cycle after applying the discount rate. Equals subscription_price × (1 - discount_rate). Used in revenue recognition, COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) analysis, and financial reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud ERP - Financials; SOX Section 404; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: next_order_date
attributes.description: Scheduled calendar date for the next automatic order generation under this subscription. Used by fulfillment systems for ATP (Available to Promise) checks and demand sensing. Updated after each successful order cycle.
attributes.references: SAP IBP - Demand Planning; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent NPS (Net Promoter Score) survey response from the subscriber, on a scale of 0–10. Used to correlate subscription satisfaction with churn risk and to segment consumers for retention and advocacy programs.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel

attributes.name: pause_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the subscription pause is scheduled to end and auto-replenishment is set to resume. Null if the pause is indefinite. Used in demand forecasting to anticipate reactivation volumes.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; SAP IBP - Demand Planning

attributes.name: pause_reason
attributes.description: Consumer-stated reason for pausing the subscription. Populated when subscription_status transitions to 'paused'. Used in consumer retention analysis and proactive re-engagement campaign targeting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: pause_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the consumer-initiated subscription pause became effective. Used to calculate pause duration and adjust next_order_date upon resumption. Supports consumer retention lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: payment_method_type
attributes.description: Category of payment instrument used for recurring subscription billing (e.g., credit_card, digital_wallet). Stored as a type reference only — no raw card or account data is stored here per PCI DSS compliance. Supports payment failure analysis and retry logic.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; Oracle Cloud ERP - Financials

attributes.name: payment_token_reference
attributes.description: Tokenized reference identifier for the consumer's stored payment method, issued by the payment processor vault. Never contains raw card or bank account data. Used to initiate recurring charges without storing PCI-sensitive data. Compliant with PCI DSS tokenization requirements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Section 3.5; GDPR Article 25 (data minimization)

attributes.name: price
attributes.description: Gross price charged to the consumer per billing cycle before any discounts are applied. Expressed in the subscription's billing currency. Used in subscription revenue forecasting and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) calculations.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud ERP - Financials; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Trade promotion or marketing coupon code applied at subscription enrollment that governs the discount_rate or introductory pricing. Ties the subscription to a TPM (Trade Promotion Management) campaign for ROI measurement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Trade Promotion; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of the subscribed SKU to be fulfilled per order cycle. Drives replenishment volume, inventory reservation, and demand planning inputs for S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning).
attributes.references: SAP IBP - Demand Planning; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the subscription became effective and the first order cycle was initiated. Represents EFFECTIVE_FROM for this agreement. Used in cohort analysis and subscription tenure calculations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: subscription_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable subscription reference number communicated to the consumer in confirmation emails, invoices, and customer service interactions. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this agreement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; GS1 Global Data Standards

attributes.name: subscription_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the subscription. 'active' = fulfilling orders; 'paused' = consumer-initiated hold; 'cancelled' = permanently terminated; 'pending' = awaiting first payment confirmation; 'expired' = plan term ended without renewal. Drives LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; GDPR Article 17 (right to erasure on cancellation)

attributes.name: subscription_type
attributes.description: Classification of the subscription program type. 'auto_replenishment' covers single-SKU DTC replenishment; 'subscription_box' covers curated multi-product boxes; 'bundle' covers fixed product bundles; 'trial' covers introductory trial subscriptions.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: total_orders_fulfilled
attributes.description: Cumulative count of successfully fulfilled subscription orders since the subscription start date. Non-derived operational counter maintained by the fulfillment system. Used in subscription tenure analysis and OTIF (On Time In Full) performance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: trial_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the trial period ends and standard subscription billing commences. Null for non-trial subscriptions. Used to trigger trial-to-paid conversion communications and revenue recognition timing.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: trial_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this subscription was initiated as a trial or introductory offer (True) or as a standard paid subscription (False). Used to segment trial-to-paid conversion analytics and NPD (New Product Development) launch performance.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; FTC Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the most recent modification to the subscription record. Represents RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and audit compliance.

domains.name: supply
domains.description: Owns end-to-end supply chain planning and orchestration including demand planning, supply planning, inventory optimization, S&OP/IBP processes, DRP execution, safety stock targets, ATP/CTP calculations, supply network design, demand sensing, forecast accuracy tracking, and supply risk management. Integrates with SAP IBP.

products.name: demand_plan
products.description: Core master entity representing the demand plan across all versions, stages, and consensus outcomes within the S&OP/IBP cycle for each SKU/location/channel/planning period combination. Each record represents a specific version-point: captures version name, version type (statistical baseline/field sales overlay/marketing-adjusted/consensus/final approved), planning cycle reference, created-by persona, approval status, effective date range, planning bucket (weekly/monthly), statistical baseline quantity, commercial overlay, marketing event uplift, new product launch volume, consensus quantity, variance to statistical baseline, channel disaggregation, promotional overlays, and lifecycle stage. The consensus version represents the single agreed demand signal passed to supply planning. Enables forecast accuracy benchmarking across versions. Sourced from SAP IBP Demand Planning module.

attributes.name: demand_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the demand plan record. Primary key representing a specific version-point in the S&OP/IBP cycle for a SKU/location/channel/planning period combination.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Integrated Demand Planning uses brand forecasts; brand_id links demand plan to specific brand for Brand Demand Forecast report.

attributes.name: product_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_category. Business justification: Business process: New Product Demand Planning ties each demand_plan to the originating R&D project, enabling planners to align forecasts with product development timelines.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Demand plans drive revenue forecasts and production costs allocated to profit centers for P&L planning, S&OP financial reconciliation, and variance analysis in consumer goods financial planning cycles

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product SKU for which demand is being planned.

attributes.name: sku_planning_param_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.sku_planning_param. Business justification: The demand plan uses SKU-level planning parameters (demand pattern type, forecast model type, planning horizon, seasonality profile) to generate statistical baseline forecasts. demand_plan already has

attributes.name: sop_cycle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the S&OP/IBP planning cycle during which this demand plan version was created.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution location, warehouse, or market geography for which demand is planned.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.trade_account. Business justification: REQUIRED: Account‑level demand forecast used in S&OP planning; planners need trade_account context for each demand_plan.

attributes.name: trade_promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.trade_promotion. Business justification: Demand plans in consumer goods must reference trade promotions to incorporate promotional baseline adjustments and uplift forecasts into S&OP consensus planning cycles. Critical for promotional demand

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the demand plan version within the S&OP governance workflow.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this demand plan version was formally approved and locked for supply planning execution.

attributes.name: commercial_overlay_quantity
attributes.description: Demand adjustment quantity applied by field sales teams based on customer intelligence, market conditions, and sales pipeline visibility.

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Planner-assigned confidence rating in the demand forecast based on data quality, market visibility, and forecast stability.

attributes.name: consensus_quantity
attributes.description: Agreed demand forecast quantity representing the single demand signal passed to supply planning after S&OP consensus process. This is the authoritative demand plan.

attributes.name: created_by_persona
attributes.description: Role or persona of the user who created this demand plan version, used for accountability and collaboration tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this demand plan version record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code used for any monetary values associated with this demand plan (e.g., revenue forecasts).

attributes.name: demand_pattern_type
attributes.description: Classification of historical demand behavior pattern used to select appropriate statistical forecasting algorithm.

attributes.name: demand_sensing_signal
attributes.description: Short-term demand trend indicator derived from real-time POS data, shipment data, and market signals to enable rapid forecast adjustments.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this demand plan version becomes active and is used for supply planning and ATP calculations.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this demand plan version remains active. Null indicates the version is currently active with no planned expiration.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_percentage
attributes.description: Historical forecast accuracy metric for this SKU/location/channel combination, used for forecast quality benchmarking and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: forecast_bias_percentage
attributes.description: Systematic tendency to over-forecast or under-forecast, calculated as average percentage deviation from actual demand.

attributes.name: is_consensus_version
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this version represents the official consensus demand plan approved through the S&OP process and used for supply planning.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this demand plan version was last updated or adjusted.

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Product lifecycle stage classification used to apply appropriate forecasting models and demand shaping strategies.

attributes.name: marketing_event_uplift_quantity
attributes.description: Incremental demand quantity expected from planned marketing campaigns, promotions, and brand activation events.

attributes.name: npd_launch_volume_quantity

attributes.name: planning_bucket

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date

attributes.name: source_system_record_code

attributes.name: statistical_baseline_quantity

attributes.name: version_type

attributes.name: approval_notes
attributes.description: Comments or notes provided by the approver during the approval process, documenting any conditions, concerns, or guidance related to this forecast version. Nullable if not yet approved or no notes provided.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this forecast version was approved. Nullable if not yet approved.

attributes.name: archived_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this forecast version was archived and moved out of active planning use. Nullable if not yet archived.

attributes.name: bias_percentage
attributes.description: Forecast bias percentage indicating systematic over-forecasting (positive bias) or under-forecasting (negative bias). A value near zero indicates an unbiased forecast. Nullable if not yet calculated.

attributes.description: The date and time when this forecast version record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for any monetary values associated with this forecast version (e.g., revenue forecasts). Nullable if forecast is purely volume-based.

attributes.name: demand_sensing_applied
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether demand sensing algorithms (short-term forecast adjustments based on real-time Point of Sale (POS) data, shipment data, or other leading indicators) were applied to this forecast version.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this forecast version becomes effective and is used for operational planning, Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP), and Available to Promise (ATP) calculations.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this forecast version remains effective. Nullable for open-ended versions that remain active until superseded.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_percentage
attributes.description: Calculated forecast accuracy percentage for this version, measured as the percentage of forecasted demand that matched actual demand. Used for benchmarking version performance and continuous improvement. Nullable if accuracy has not yet been calculated.

attributes.name: forecast_source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system or application that generated or contributed to this forecast version (e.g., 'SAP IBP', 'TradeEdge', 'Excel Upload', 'Salesforce CG Cloud').

attributes.name: is_consensus_version
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this version represents the consensus forecast agreed upon by cross-functional stakeholders (sales, marketing, supply chain, finance) during the S&OP process.

attributes.name: is_final_approved_version
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this version is the final approved forecast that will be used for operational execution, Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP).

attributes.name: mean_absolute_percentage_error
attributes.description: Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) metric for this forecast version, measuring the average magnitude of forecast errors as a percentage. Lower values indicate better forecast accuracy. Nullable if not yet calculated.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this forecast version record was last modified.

attributes.name: new_product_introduction_included
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether New Product Development (NPD) or New Product Introduction (NPI) launches were incorporated into this forecast version.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the planning period covered by this forecast version (e.g., end of the fiscal quarter or rolling 18-month horizon).

attributes.name: planning_horizon_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the planning period covered by this forecast version (e.g., start of the fiscal quarter or month).

attributes.name: promotional_events_included
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether trade promotions, marketing campaigns, and promotional events were factored into this forecast version.

attributes.name: rejection_reason

attributes.name: statistical_model_applied
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the statistical forecasting model or algorithm applied to generate or adjust this forecast version (e.g., 'Exponential Smoothing', 'ARIMA', 'Machine Learning Ensemble', 'Holt-Winters'). Nullable if no statistical model was used.

attributes.name: time_bucket
attributes.description: The time granularity or bucket size used for this forecast version: daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annual periods.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which forecast quantities are expressed (e.g., 'EA' for each, 'CS' for case, 'KG' for kilogram, 'L' for liter). Aligns with GS1 standards.

attributes.name: version_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code or identifier for the forecast version used in system integrations and reporting (e.g., 'STAT_BASE', 'CONS_V1', 'FINAL_APR').

attributes.name: version_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description or notes about this forecast version, including assumptions, adjustments made, special considerations, or rationale for key changes.

attributes.name: version_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name assigned to this forecast version (e.g., 'Statistical Baseline Q1 2024', 'Consensus Forecast March', 'Final Approved Version').

attributes.name: version_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number indicating the iteration or revision order of this forecast version within the planning cycle (e.g., 1 for first draft, 2 for first revision, 3 for consensus).

attributes.name: version_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the forecast version: draft (under construction), in review (submitted for approval), approved (validated and accepted), rejected (not accepted), archived (historical record), or active (currently in use for planning).

attributes.name: version_type
attributes.description: Classification of the forecast version indicating its role in the planning process: statistical baseline (system-generated), field sales overlay (sales team input), marketing adjusted (marketing promotions incorporated), consensus (collaborative agreement), final approved (executive sign-off), or simulation (what-if scenario).

products.name: inventory_policy
products.description: Master entity defining inventory policy parameters, safety stock calculations, service level commitments, and OTIF targets for each SKU/location node in the supply network. Captures safety stock target and calculated quantities (days of supply, units, calculation method, demand variability, lead time variability, service level input, calculated vs approved SS units, effective date, review status), reorder point, min/max levels, cycle stock target, replenishment method (MRP/DRP/VMI), review cycle, service level targets (fill rate %, on-time delivery %, OTIF composite %), customer/channel-level OTIF commitments, retailer-mandated target flags, penalty clause indicators, and measurement windows. Owned by supply planning; consumed by distribution and manufacturing execution.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: profit_center_id

Distinct from inventory_policy (policy target) as this captures the actual calculated output.

attributes.description: The ABC classification of the SKU based on revenue contribution or volume. A items are high-value requiring tight control; B items are moderate; C items are low-value. Influences service level targets and safety stock investment decisions.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the safety stock calculation was approved by the planner. Marks the transition from calculated to approved state in the workflow.

attributes.name: approved_safety_stock_units
attributes.description: The final approved safety stock quantity in base units of measure after planner review and adjustment. This is the target value used for inventory policy execution and Available to Promise (ATP) calculations.

attributes.name: average_daily_demand_units
attributes.description: The mean daily demand quantity in base units of measure. Used as input to safety stock calculations and represents expected consumption rate.

attributes.name: average_lead_time_days
attributes.description: The mean replenishment lead time in days from order placement to receipt. Used in safety stock calculations to determine the exposure period for demand and supply variability.

attributes.name: calculated_safety_stock_units
attributes.description: The system-calculated safety stock quantity in base units of measure. This is the raw output from the calculation engine before any manual adjustments or approvals.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the safety stock quantity. Statistical methods use demand and lead time variability; days-of-supply uses fixed coverage targets; manual override represents planner judgment; service level and lead time methods focus on specific risk factors; hybrid combines multiple approaches.

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the safety stock calculation was executed by the planning system. Provides audit trail for calculation runs and version control.

attributes.name: days_of_supply_target
attributes.description: The target safety stock coverage expressed in days of average demand. Used when calculation method is days-of-supply based. Represents the buffer duration to protect against stockouts.

attributes.description: The demand pattern category for this SKU-location. Steady indicates consistent demand; seasonal shows periodic peaks; erratic has high variability; lumpy has infrequent large orders; intermittent has sporadic demand; obsolete indicates phase-out. Influences calculation method selection.

attributes.name: demand_variability_coefficient
attributes.description: Statistical measure of demand volatility expressed as coefficient of variation or standard deviation. Used in statistical safety stock calculations to quantify demand uncertainty.

attributes.description: The date when this safety stock target becomes active and is used for inventory policy execution, Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP), and Available to Promise (ATP) calculations.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_percent
attributes.description: The historical forecast accuracy for this SKU-location combination expressed as a percentage. Used to adjust safety stock calculations based on forecasting reliability. Lower accuracy typically requires higher safety stock.

attributes.name: holding_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: The annual cost to hold one unit of inventory including warehousing, insurance, obsolescence, and capital cost. Used in inventory optimization to balance service level against carrying cost. Expressed in local currency.
attributes.references: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and Inventory Valuation Standards

attributes.description: The date and time when the safety stock record was last reviewed by a planner, regardless of whether changes were made. Used to track planner engagement and ensure regular review cycles.

attributes.name: lead_time_variability_days

attributes.description: The date and time when this safety stock record was last modified. Updated whenever any field changes. Supports change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.references: Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) Best Practices

attributes.name: order_multiple
attributes.description: The order quantity increment or lot size multiple required by supplier or production constraints. Safety stock and reorder quantities must align with this multiple.

attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the planner when manually overriding the calculated safety stock. Documents the business context and rationale for the adjustment.

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: The business reason code when approved safety stock differs from calculated safety stock. Captures planner judgment factors such as promotional events, seasonal peaks, supply chain risks, new product introductions, product phase-outs, or quality concerns.

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the planning period for which this safety stock calculation is effective. Defines the validity window for the safety stock target.

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the planning period for which this safety stock calculation is effective. Used in Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) and Integrated Business Planning (IBP) cycles.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status of the safety stock calculation. Pending review indicates awaiting planner action; approved means active for execution; rejected requires recalculation; under revision is being adjusted; expired indicates the planning period has passed.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The shelf life or expiration period of the product in days. Critical for Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) and Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) safety stock decisions to prevent obsolescence. Influences maximum safety stock levels and First Expired First Out (FEFO) policies.
attributes.references: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and Quality Management Standards

attributes.name: supply_risk_score
attributes.description: A quantitative risk score assessing supply chain vulnerability for this SKU-location. Higher scores indicate greater risk from supplier reliability, geopolitical factors, transportation disruptions, or single-source dependencies. Used to adjust safety stock buffers.

attributes.name: target_service_level_percent
attributes.description: The desired in-stock probability or fill rate target expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00, 98.50). Drives the safety stock buffer size to achieve the specified On Shelf Availability (OSA) or Service Level Agreement (SLA).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for safety stock quantities. EA=Each, CS=Case, PL=Pallet, KG=Kilogram, LB=Pound, L=Liter, GAL=Gallon. Must align with SKU base unit of measure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|KG|LB|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: xyz_classification
attributes.description: The XYZ classification based on demand variability. X items have low variability (predictable); Y items have moderate variability; Z items have high variability (unpredictable). Used alongside ABC to determine safety stock strategy.

attributes.name: z_score
attributes.description: The standard normal distribution value corresponding to the target service level. Used in statistical safety stock formulas to translate service level percentage into buffer quantity.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this consensus demand record was first created in the system. Part of standard audit trail.

attributes.name: customer_commitment_quantity
attributes.description: Demand volume backed by firm customer orders, contracts, or commitments for this planning period. Represents the most reliable component of consensus demand.

attributes.name: demand_category
attributes.description: Classification of the demand type to enable segmented planning and analysis. Base demand represents ongoing business; promotional and seasonal reflect event-driven spikes; new launch and phase-out support lifecycle transitions.

attributes.name: demand_driver_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary business driver or causal factor influencing this demand (e.g., holiday season, weather pattern, competitive action, regulatory change). Supports root-cause analysis.

attributes.name: demand_driver_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the demand driver or business rationale behind the consensus demand figure. Captures qualitative insights from demand planners and commercial teams.

attributes.name: demand_volatility_index
attributes.description: Statistical measure of demand variability for this SKU/location combination, typically expressed as coefficient of variation. Higher values indicate greater uncertainty and require higher safety stock.

attributes.name: forecast_accuracy_previous_period
attributes.description: The forecast accuracy percentage achieved for this SKU/location combination in the previous planning period. Used to assess forecasting performance trends and adjust confidence levels.

attributes.name: forecast_model_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the statistical forecasting model or algorithm used to generate the baseline statistical forecast (e.g., exponential smoothing, ARIMA, machine learning model).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this consensus demand record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this consensus demand record was last reviewed and validated by the demand planning team during the S&OP demand review meeting.

attributes.name: marketing_event_uplift_quantity
attributes.description: Incremental demand volume expected from planned marketing campaigns, promotions, or trade events during this planning period.

attributes.name: new_product_launch_quantity
attributes.description: Demand volume attributed to new product introductions or product launches scheduled for this planning period. Typically based on launch plans and market sizing.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next S&OP demand review when this consensus demand will be re-evaluated and updated based on latest market intelligence.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_type
attributes.description: Classification of the planning time horizon for this demand record. Short-term (0-3 months) is firm; medium-term (3-12 months) is flexible; long-term (12+ months) is strategic.

attributes.name: promotion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consensus demand includes uplift from planned trade promotions or marketing events. True means promotional activity is planned; false means base demand only.

attributes.name: seasonality_factor
attributes.description: Multiplicative factor representing seasonal demand patterns for this planning period. Values above 1.0 indicate peak season; below 1.0 indicate off-season.

attributes.name: statistical_forecast_quantity
attributes.description: The baseline demand forecast generated by statistical forecasting algorithms before any manual adjustments or commercial overlays. Serves as the starting point for consensus demand.

attributes.name: unconstrained_demand_quantity
attributes.description: The theoretical demand volume if all supply constraints (capacity, materials, inventory) were removed. Used for capacity planning and investment decisions.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which consensus demand quantity is expressed (each, case, pallet, kilogram, liter, etc.). Must align with product master UOM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PAL|KG|LB|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage variance between consensus demand and statistical forecast, calculated as (variance_to_statistical / statistical_forecast_quantity) * 100. Used to monitor forecast override patterns.

attributes.name: variance_to_statistical
attributes.description: The difference between consensus demand quantity and statistical forecast quantity. Positive values indicate upward adjustments; negative values indicate downward adjustments. Key metric for forecast bias analysis.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number tracking iterations of this consensus demand record within the same S&OP cycle. Increments with each revision to support change history.

products.name: sku_planning_param
products.description: Master entity storing SKU-level planning parameters used in demand and supply planning calculations. Captures planning horizon, lot size, minimum order quantity (MOQ), shelf life (days), FEFO/FIFO flag, planning strategy (make-to-stock/make-to-order), ABC/XYZ classification, demand pattern type, seasonality index, and IBP planning group assignment. Distinct from product master (owned by product domain) as this captures supply-planning-specific parameters.

attributes.name: sku_planning_param_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) Planning Parameter ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SKU planning parameter record. Primary key for this entity.

tag_set.value: Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) Planning Parameter ID

attributes.name: inspection_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_plan. Business justification: SKU planning parameters must reference applicable inspection plans to calculate goods_receipt_processing_time_days and quality hold periods in MRP logic. Consumer goods MRP systems incorporate inspect

attributes.name: inventory_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inventory_policy. Business justification: sku_planning_param stores SKU-level operational planning parameters (MRP type, lot size, reorder point, safety stock method). inventory_policy defines the inventory policy governing the same SKU/locat

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or production facility where this SKU is produced or sourced. Used for plant-specific planning parameters.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU in the product master. Links planning parameters to the specific product variant being planned.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: sku_planning_param needs to be associated with the network node it applies to; added new FK supply_network_node_id referencing network_node.supply_network_node_id.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: ABC inventory classification based on revenue contribution or consumption value. A items are high-value requiring tight control, C items are low-value with relaxed control.
attributes.references: Inventory Management Best Practices - Pareto Analysis

attributes.name: backorder_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether backorders are permitted for this SKU when inventory is insufficient. True allows demand to be backordered, false requires immediate fulfillment or cancellation.

attributes.name: coverage_profile_days
attributes.description: Target days of supply to maintain in inventory. Represents desired inventory coverage horizon based on demand forecast and replenishment frequency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this planning parameter record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: critical_part_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is classified as a critical part requiring special planning attention. Critical parts may have higher service levels or expedited replenishment.

attributes.name: demand_pattern_type
attributes.description: Characterization of the SKUs historical demand pattern. Determines appropriate forecasting method and safety stock calculation approach.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which these planning parameters are no longer active. Null indicates parameters are currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which these planning parameters become active and are used by planning systems. Supports time-phased parameter changes.

attributes.name: fixed_lot_size_quantity
attributes.description: Fixed production or procurement lot size quantity when using fixed lot size method. Represents standard batch size for manufacturing or ordering.

attributes.name: forecast_model_type
attributes.description: Statistical or machine learning model used for demand forecasting. Determines the algorithm applied during forecast generation in IBP or demand planning systems.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_processing_time_days
attributes.description: Time required for quality inspection and goods receipt processing after physical delivery. Adds to total replenishment lead time.
attributes.references: Quality Management and Warehouse Operations Standards

attributes.name: inventory_valuation_method
attributes.description: Method used for inventory valuation and consumption. FIFO (First In First Out), FEFO (First Expired First Out), LIFO (Last In First Out), or weighted average costing.
attributes.references: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) - Inventory Accounting

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this planning parameter record was last updated. Tracks most recent change for change management and audit purposes.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when planning parameters were last reviewed and validated by the planning team. Supports periodic parameter maintenance and accuracy audits.

attributes.name: lot_size_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate production or procurement lot sizes. Determines how order quantities are calculated in MRP and supply planning runs.

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity that can be ordered or produced in a single transaction. Limited by production capacity, storage constraints, or supplier capabilities.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum inventory level target for this SKU. Used in min-max planning to cap inventory investment and prevent overstock situations.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered or produced in a single transaction. Enforced by supplier contracts or manufacturing constraints.

attributes.name: minimum_remaining_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Minimum remaining shelf life required at time of shipment to customer or retail delivery. Ensures product quality and retailer acceptance.

attributes.name: mrp_controller_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the MRP controller or planner responsible for this SKU. Used for workload assignment and exception management routing.

attributes.name: mrp_type
attributes.description: MRP procedure that controls how the planning system generates procurement proposals. Determines planning logic and automation level.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for next planning parameter review. Ensures regular validation of planning assumptions and parameter accuracy.

attributes.name: order_multiple_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity increment in which orders must be placed. All order quantities must be multiples of this value due to packaging or production constraints.

attributes.name: parameter_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special planning considerations, parameter rationale, or exceptions for this SKU. Provides context for planning decisions.

attributes.name: parameter_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the planning parameter record. Active parameters are used in planning runs, inactive parameters are ignored.

attributes.name: planned_delivery_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days from order placement to goods receipt. Used for MRP scheduling and supply plan timing calculations.
attributes.references: Material Requirements Planning (MRP) Lead Time Standards

attributes.name: planning_group
attributes.description: IBP planning group assignment for demand and supply planning segmentation. Groups SKUs with similar planning characteristics for collaborative planning processes.

attributes.name: planning_horizon_days
attributes.description: Number of days into the future for which demand and supply planning is performed. Defines the forward-looking planning window for this SKU.
attributes.references: Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) Best Practices

attributes.name: planning_strategy
attributes.description: Manufacturing planning strategy that determines how the SKU is planned and produced. Make-to-stock produces to forecast, make-to-order produces against customer orders.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Material Master Planning Strategy

attributes.name: planning_time_fence_days
attributes.description: Number of days within which the planning system cannot automatically change planned orders without planner approval. Protects near-term production schedule stability.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is externally procured from suppliers, produced in-house, or both. Determines supply planning logic and sourcing strategy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Material Master Procurement Type

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: Inventory level that triggers a replenishment order. Calculated based on lead time demand plus safety stock to prevent stockouts.

attributes.name: rounding_profile_code
attributes.description: Code defining rounding rules for planned order quantities. Ensures quantities align with packaging units, pallet configurations, or production batch constraints.

attributes.name: safety_stock_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate safety stock levels. Fixed quantity uses static buffer, service level based uses demand variability and lead time uncertainty.

attributes.name: seasonality_profile_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the seasonality pattern applied to this SKU for demand forecasting. Links to predefined seasonal index curves (e.g., summer peak, holiday spike).

attributes.name: service_level_target_percent
attributes.description: Target service level percentage for this SKU (e.g., 95%, 98%, 99%). Drives safety stock calculation to achieve desired product availability.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Total shelf life of the SKU in days from production date to expiration. Critical for FEFO inventory management and demand planning for perishable goods.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for all planning quantities (e.g., EA for each, CS for case, KG for kilogram). Standardizes quantity representation across planning processes.

attributes.name: xyz_classification
attributes.description: XYZ demand variability classification. X items have stable demand, Y items have moderate variability, Z items have highly erratic or sporadic demand patterns.

domains.name: sales
domains.description: Owns commercial sales execution, order management, and revenue transactions across all channels (retail, wholesale, DTC, e-commerce). Manages sales orders, pricing agreements, sales force automation (SFA), retail account call records, POG compliance, RSP/MSRP price management, ACV/TDP/SOM metrics, and field sales KPIs. Integrates with Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.

products.name: trade_account
products.description: SSOT master record for all B2B trade customers including retailers, distributors, wholesalers, and foodservice operators. Captures authoritative account identity: legal entity name, trade channel classification (grocery, mass, club, drug, foodservice, e-commerce), account tier, credit rating, payment terms, currency, tax identifiers, DUNS number, GLN (GS1 Global Location Number), primary language, account status, lifecycle dates, and full status change audit history (previous status, new status, change reason, change timestamp, changed-by user). This is the golden record for all trade partner identity — every other customer domain entity references this product via FK.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Customer Master (SD), Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Account

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the B2B trade account. Primary key for the trade account master record.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profitability analysis assigns each customer to a profit center to aggregate revenue and margin in financial reporting.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.territory. Business justification: Trade accounts (retailers, distributors, wholesalers) are assigned to sales territories for field coverage and quota management. Adding territory_id to trade_account directly captures the primary terr

attributes.name: account_close_date
attributes.description: The date when this trade account was permanently closed or terminated, if applicable.

attributes.name: account_open_date
attributes.description: The date when this trade account was first established and approved for business transactions.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the trade account: active (operational), inactive (dormant), suspended (temporarily blocked), pending approval (new account under review), credit hold (payment issues), or closed (permanently terminated).

attributes.name: account_tier
attributes.description: Strategic tier classification based on account size, coverage, and business importance: Tier 1 (national key accounts), Tier 2 (regional chains), Tier 3 (local/metro accounts), Tier 4 (independent operators).

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The business model classification of the trade partner: retailer (sells to end consumers), distributor (logistics and fulfillment), wholesaler (bulk reseller), foodservice operator (restaurants/catering), or broker (sales intermediary).

attributes.name: acv_total
attributes.description: The total All Commodity Volume representing the annual dollar sales volume across all product categories for this retail account, used for market coverage analysis.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: The maximum outstanding accounts receivable balance allowed for this trade account before credit hold is applied.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: The credit risk rating assigned to this trade account by internal credit management or external credit bureau (e.g., AAA, AA, A, BBB, BB, B, CCC, D).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all financial transactions with this trade account (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR, MXN).

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: The trade name or DBA name under which the account operates in the market, if different from legal entity name.

attributes.name: dsd_delivery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trade account receives direct store delivery (DSD) shipments bypassing the retailers distribution center.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: The 9-digit DUNS number assigned by Dun & Bradstreet for unique identification of the business entity.

attributes.name: edi_capable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trade account has EDI connectivity enabled for electronic exchange of purchase orders, invoices, and advance ship notices.

attributes.name: gln
attributes.description: The 13-digit GS1 Global Location Number uniquely identifying the legal entity and physical location of the trade partner.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line1
attributes.description: The first line of the street address for the trade account headquarters or primary business location.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line2
attributes.description: The second line of the street address (suite, floor, building) for the trade account headquarters.

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: The city name of the trade account headquarters location.

attributes.name: headquarters_country_code
attributes.description: The 3-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the trade account headquarters location (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: headquarters_postal_code
attributes.description: The postal code or ZIP code of the trade account headquarters location.

attributes.name: headquarters_state_province
attributes.description: The state, province, or administrative region of the trade account headquarters location.

attributes.name: last_order_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent purchase order received from this trade account.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: The official registered legal name of the trade partner organization as it appears on legal documents and contracts.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum order quantity (in units or cases) required for orders placed by this trade account.

attributes.name: otif_sla_target_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Percent
attributes.description: The contractual OTIF service level agreement target percentage for order fulfillment performance (e.g., 95.00 represents 95% of orders delivered on time and in full).

tag_set.value: On Time In Full (OTIF) Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Percent

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The primary payment instrument used by this account: ACH (automated clearing house), wire transfer, check, EDI payment (electronic funds transfer via EDI 820), or credit card.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The standard payment terms code governing invoice payment due dates and early payment discounts (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30).

attributes.name: previous_status
attributes.description: The account status immediately prior to the most recent status change, maintained for audit trail and lifecycle analysis.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: The business email address of the primary contact for order management, invoicing, and account communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: The full name of the primary business contact or account manager at the trade partner organization.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: The business phone number of the primary contact, including country code and extension if applicable.

attributes.name: primary_language_code
attributes.description: The 2-letter ISO 639-1 language code for the preferred communication language with this trade account (e.g., en, es, fr, de).

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this trade account master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this trade account master record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: status_change_reason
attributes.description: The business reason or justification for the most recent account status change (e.g., payment default, business closure, credit improvement, contract renewal).

attributes.name: status_change_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the most recent account status change occurred.

attributes.name: status_changed_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who executed the most recent account status change, for audit and accountability purposes.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trade account holds a valid tax exemption certificate for sales tax or VAT purposes.

attributes.name: tax_number
attributes.description: The government-issued tax identification number for this legal entity (e.g., EIN in USA, VAT number in EU, GST number in other jurisdictions).

attributes.name: tdp_count
attributes.description: The total number of distribution points (store locations or outlets) operated by this trade account where products can be sold.

attributes.name: trade_channel
attributes.description: The primary retail or distribution channel through which this trade account operates: grocery (supermarkets), mass (mass merchandisers), club (warehouse clubs), drug (pharmacy chains), convenience stores, foodservice (restaurants/institutions), or e-commerce (online retailers). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grocery|mass|club|drug|convenience|foodservice|e-commerce — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vmi_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trade account participates in a VMI program where the supplier manages inventory replenishment based on POS or warehouse data.

products.name: account_contact

Captures full name, job title, department, contact role (primary buyer, logistics, finance, marketing), phone, email, preferred communication channel, active status, and opt-in/opt-out flags for commercial communications. Supports SFA and retail execution workflows in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.

attributes.name: account_contact_id

attributes.description: Reference to another account contact record representing this contact's direct manager or supervisor within the trade account organization. Enables organizational hierarchy mapping.

attributes.name: trade_account_id

attributes.name: assistant_name
attributes.description: The name of the contact's administrative assistant or executive assistant, if applicable. Used for scheduling and communication routing.

attributes.name: assistant_phone
attributes.description: The phone number of the contact's administrative assistant. Used for scheduling and communication routing.

attributes.name: contact_notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for capturing additional notes, preferences, or context about the contact. Used by sales representatives to document relationship insights.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Management

attributes.name: contact_role

attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record. Active contacts are currently employed and engaged with the account. Inactive or terminated contacts are retained for historical reference.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Management

attributes.name: contact_type

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contact record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The organizational department or functional area within the trade account where this contact works. Examples include Procurement, Logistics, Finance, Marketing.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Management

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this contact's role at the trade account ended, if applicable. Null for currently active contacts. Used for historical tracking and relationship continuity.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this contact became active in their current role at the trade account. Used for tracking tenure and relationship history.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Management

attributes.name: email_address

attributes.name: fax_number

attributes.name: first_name

attributes.name: full_name

attributes.name: is_decision_maker

attributes.name: is_primary_contact

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The official job title or position held by the contact at the trade account organization. Examples include Senior Buyer, Category Manager, Supply Chain Director.

attributes.name: language_preference

attributes.name: last_contact_date

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contact record was most recently updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_name

attributes.name: linkedin_profile_url
attributes.description: The URL of the contact's LinkedIn professional profile. Used for social selling and relationship intelligence.

attributes.name: mobile_number
attributes.description: Mobile or cellular phone number for the contact. Used for urgent communications and field-based retail execution activities.

attributes.name: next_follow_up_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next planned follow-up or interaction with this contact. Supports proactive account management and sales cadence planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Activity Management

attributes.name: opt_in_email

attributes.name: opt_in_phone
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the contact has opted in to receive commercial phone communications. True if opted in, False if opted out. Required for telemarketing compliance.

attributes.name: opt_in_sms
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the contact has opted in to receive commercial SMS or text message communications. True if opted in, False if opted out.

attributes.name: phone_number

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel

attributes.name: salesforce_user_code

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: gln

attributes.name: inactivation_reason

attributes.name: latitude

attributes.name: longitude

attributes.name: postal_code

attributes.name: primary_address_flag

attributes.name: receiving_hours_end

attributes.name: receiving_hours_start
attributes.description: Start time for receiving deliveries at this location in 24-hour format (HH:mm). Used for delivery scheduling and On Time In Full (OTIF) compliance.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this address in the source system of record. Used for data reconciliation and bidirectional synchronization.

attributes.name: standardized_address_flag

attributes.name: state_province

products.name: order
products.description: Core sales order record capturing all commercial sales transactions across retail, wholesale, DTC, and e-commerce channels. Contains order header details (order number, date, channel type, status, delivery dates, OTIF status, payment terms, currency, totals, SAP SD document number) and line-level detail (SKU/GTIN, quantities ordered/confirmed/shipped, unit pricing, discounts, trade promotion references, line status, COGS, gross margin, delivery schedule). Serves as the primary transactional backbone of the sales domain enabling both order-level and SKU-level revenue and margin analysis.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the sales order record. Primary key for the order entity.

attributes.name: account_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer location that receives the invoice and is responsible for payment. May differ from ship-to location.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost Center Allocation report requires each sales order to be charged to a cost center for internal expense tracking.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or distribution center assigned to fulfill this order. Determines inventory allocation and shipping origin.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promotion_event. Business justification: Order‑level Promotion Event Attribution report requires linking each order to the specific promotion event that generated the sale.

attributes.name: pricing_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.pricing_agreement. Business justification: Orders are governed by a pricing agreement; linking captures contract context.

attributes.name: product_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_category. Business justification: Required for linking each sales order to the R&D project that created the product, enabling ROI and product launch performance reporting.

attributes.name: profit_center_id

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer location where goods should be delivered. May differ from bill-to location for multi-site customers.

attributes.name: sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative or account manager who created or owns this order. Used for commission calculation and SFA reporting.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: Order Fulfillment Allocation report requires linking each order to the supply network node that will source inventory for accurate ATP/CTP calculations.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.territory. Business justification: Directly assigning a territory to an order simplifies reporting and analytics.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or retail account that placed this order. Links to the customer master record.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the order was delivered to the customer. Used to calculate OTIF performance and delivery variance.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the order was approved for fulfillment. Marks transition from draft/pending to confirmed status in the order lifecycle.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for order cancellation if status is cancelled. Used for root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: The commercial channel through which the order was received. Critical for channel-specific analytics and revenue attribution.

attributes.name: cogs_amount
attributes.description: Total cost of goods sold for all items on this order. Used for gross margin calculation and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by supply chain and logistics based on ATP/CTP availability. Committed date for OTIF tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this order record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all monetary amounts on this order. Determines currency for pricing, tax, and totals.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to the order including trade promotions, volume discounts, and negotiated price reductions.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which products are sold. Defines the route-to-market and channel-specific pricing rules.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: The product division or business unit for this order. Used for divisional P&L reporting and product line segmentation.

attributes.name: freight_amount
attributes.description: Freight and shipping charges applied to the order. May be customer-paid or supplier-absorbed depending on terms.

attributes.name: gross_margin_amount
attributes.description: Gross profit on the order calculated as total revenue less COGS. Key profitability metric for order-level margin analysis.

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: Three-letter Incoterm code defining the transfer of risk and cost responsibility between buyer and seller. Examples: FOB, CIF, DDP.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this order record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The date when the sales order was placed or created by the customer. Primary business event timestamp for order lifecycle.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the sales order. Used for customer communication and order tracking across systems.

attributes.name: order_status

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the order based on fulfillment method and business process. Determines routing, pricing, and delivery rules.

attributes.name: otif_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order was delivered on time and in full per customer commitment. Key supply chain KPI for customer service measurement.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The payment terms code defining the credit period and discount conditions for this order. Examples: NET30, 2/10NET30.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority classification for order fulfillment. Determines sequencing in warehouse picking and expedited shipping eligibility.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date

attributes.name: shipping_method

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for customer-specific delivery instructions, packaging requirements, or handling notes for warehouse and logistics teams.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all line item amounts before taxes, discounts, and freight charges. Base revenue amount for the order.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount charged on the order including sales tax, VAT, GST, and other applicable taxes per jurisdiction.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount for the order including subtotal, taxes, freight, less discounts. The invoiced amount for revenue recognition.

products.name: invoice

Links to the originating sales order and serves as the accounts receivable source record enabling SKU-level revenue and profitability reporting.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the invoice record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_address_id

attributes.name: event_id

attributes.description: Timestamp when the invoice was cancelled or voided. Null for active invoices. Used for cancelled invoice reporting and audit.

attributes.name: cost_of_goods_sold_amount

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: notes

products.name: assignment
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment relationship between sales representatives and trade accounts. It captures the coverage model for field sales territory management, including role-based assignments (primary rep, secondary rep, key account manager), effective date ranges for assignment history, and call planning parameters. Each record links one rep to one trade account with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific assignment.. Existence Justification: In consumer goods field sales operations, sales representatives are assigned to cover multiple trade accounts simultaneously (a field rep may cover 50-200 accounts in their territory), and trade accounts are routinely covered by multiple sales representatives in different roles (e.g., a major grocery chain may have a primary rep, a key account manager, a national account manager, and inside sales support all assigned concurrently). The assignment relationship is actively managed by sales operations teams through territory planning, account reassignment, and coverage optimization processes.

Secondary rep provides backup coverage. Key account manager handles strategic accounts. National account manager covers enterprise-level relationships. Inside sales support provides remote assistance. DSD driver handles direct store delivery accounts.

domains.name: quality
domains.description: Owns quality assurance, quality control, and GMP compliance data across the product lifecycle. Manages QC inspection results, non-conformance records, CAPA processes, batch release decisions, stability studies, certificate of analysis, GMP audit findings, supplier quality assessments, product complaints, and regulatory hold events. Integrates with SAP QM and Veeva Vault.

products.name: inspection_plan
products.description: Master data defining QC inspection plans and quality specifications for raw materials, in-process intermediates, packaging, and finished goods. Captures sampling procedures, inspection characteristics with specification limits (USL/LSL/target), acceptable quality levels (AQL), test methods, units of measure, effective date ranges, and GMP-mandated control points. Serves as the single authoritative source for what to test, how to sample, and what limits apply — governing all inspection lot execution and feeding CoA generation. Aligned with SAP QM inspection planning.
