attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this inspection plan becomes valid and applicable for quality inspections. Part of the plan's effective date range.
attributes.references: SAP QM Validity Period; GMP Change Control

attributes.name: gmp_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inspection plan covers GMP-critical quality attributes that directly impact product safety, efficacy, or regulatory compliance. GMP-critical inspections require enhanced documentation and cannot be skipped.

attributes.name: inspection_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Expected number of calendar days required to complete all inspections and testing defined in this plan. Used for production scheduling and inventory planning.
attributes.references: SAP QM Lead Time; S&OP Planning

attributes.name: inspection_method
attributes.description: Primary method used to perform the inspection: manual measurement, automated testing, laboratory analysis, visual examination, destructive testing, or non-destructive testing.
attributes.references: SAP QM Inspection Method; GMP Testing Procedures

attributes.name: inspection_severity
attributes.description: Severity level of inspection based on supplier quality history and risk assessment. Tightened inspection applies stricter acceptance criteria.
attributes.references: ISO 2859 Inspection Levels; SAP QM Dynamic Modification

attributes.name: inspection_stage
attributes.description: Production or supply chain stage at which this inspection is triggered. Aligns with GMP critical control points.
attributes.references: GMP Critical Control Points; SAP QM Inspection Origin

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Type of quality inspection this plan governs: incoming (supplier materials), in-process (production intermediates), final (finished goods), stability (shelf-life studies), release (batch release), or periodic (routine surveillance).
attributes.references: SAP QM Inspection Type; ISO 9001; GMP Quality Control

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this inspection plan record. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Classification of the material subject to inspection. Determines applicable GMP requirements and inspection rigor.
attributes.references: SAP QM Material Classification; GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this inspection plan. GMP requires regular review of quality procedures to ensure continued appropriateness.
attributes.references: GMP Periodic Review; ISO 9001 Management Review

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the inspection plan, used across quality management systems and documentation. Externally visible code for referencing the plan in quality specifications and batch records.
attributes.references: SAP QM Inspection Plan; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the inspection plan including scope, objectives, and special instructions for quality control personnel.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the inspection plan describing its purpose and scope.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inspection plan. Only active plans are used for inspection lot creation.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory requirement, standard, or guideline that mandates this inspection (e.g., FDA 21 CFR Part 211, EU GMP Annex 1, ISO 22716). Critical for compliance audits.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EU GMP; ISO 22716; REACH Regulation

attributes.name: responsible_inspector_role
attributes.description: Job role or qualification level required for personnel authorized to perform inspections under this plan (e.g., QC Technician, QC Analyst, QC Manager). Ensures competency requirements are met.
attributes.references: GMP Personnel Qualification; SAP QM Authorization

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision number of this inspection plan. Incremented each time the plan is updated. Part of change control and audit trail.
attributes.references: GMP Change Control; SAP QM Version Management

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of sample units to be drawn per inspection lot. Determined by statistical sampling plan and AQL requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 2859 Acceptance Sampling; SAP QM Sample Size

attributes.name: sample_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the sample (e.g., pieces, kg, liters, containers). Defines what constitutes one sample unit.
attributes.references: SAP QM Unit of Measure; ISO Standards

attributes.name: sampling_procedure_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the sampling procedure to be followed: sample size, sampling frequency, sampling method (random, systematic, stratified). References approved sampling SOP.
attributes.references: SAP QM Sampling Procedure; ISO 2859 Sampling Plans; GMP Sampling Guidelines

attributes.name: skip_lot_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether skip-lot inspection (reduced frequency based on consistent quality history) is permitted for this plan. Not allowed for GMP-critical inspections.
attributes.references: ISO 2859 Skip-Lot Procedures; SAP QM Dynamic Modification

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this inspection plan in the source operational system. Enables traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Data Governance; SAP QM Inspection Plan Key

attributes.name: specification_version
attributes.description: Version number of the quality specification document that this inspection plan implements. Ensures traceability to approved specifications.
attributes.references: GMP Document Control; SAP QM Specification Management

attributes.name: test_equipment_required
attributes.description: List or description of test equipment, instruments, or laboratory apparatus required to execute this inspection plan. Ensures resource availability.
attributes.references: SAP QM Test Equipment; GMP Equipment Qualification

products.name: inspection_lot
products.description: Transactional record of a QC inspection lot triggered by a production batch, goods receipt, or periodic review. Tracks lot origin (batch, purchase order, production order), inspection type, assigned inspection plan, lot quantity, inspection status, and complete disposition lifecycle including formal usage decision (accept/reject/restricted use/rework), decision maker, decision date, decision code, stock posting instruction, regulatory hold flag, and disposition outcome. Core operational entity in SAP QM representing the end-to-end inspection-to-disposition workflow.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inspection lot. Primary key for the inspection lot entity representing a discrete QC inspection event triggered by production batch, goods receipt, or periodic review.
attributes.references: SAP QM Module - Inspection Lot Object

attributes.name: batch_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.batch_record. Business justification: Required for traceability: each inspection lot must be linked to the specific manufacturing batch record that produced the lot, enabling batch-level quality release decisions.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: QC lab and inspection activities are charged to cost centers in consumer goods manufacturing. Linking inspection lots to cost centers enables QC cost tracking by lot, supporting manufacturing cost rep

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.goods_receipt. Business justification: In SAP QM/MM integration, an inspection lot is directly triggered by a goods receipt posting. Linking inspection_lot to goods_receipt enables the standard GR-triggered inspection workflow and supports

attributes.name: inbound_receipt_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.inbound_receipt_line. Business justification: Required for traceability: inspection lot must reference the inbound receipt line that supplied the lot, enabling quality inspection reports to be linked to receipt data for OTIF and compliance audits

attributes.name: inspection_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the inspection plan template applied to this lot. Defines the characteristics to be inspected, sampling procedures, and acceptance criteria.

attributes.name: inventory_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.inventory_position. Business justification: Incoming inspection lots are held in quarantine inventory until a usage decision is made. The inspection_lot must reference the inventory_position managing quarantine stock to enable WMS-driven hold/r

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.manufacturing_facility. Business justification: Needed for integrated quality‑environmental reporting: associate each inspected lot with its carbon emission record to calculate emissions per lot.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Required for traceability: link each inspection lot to the purchase order that supplied the material, enabling regulatory compliance and release decisions.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the material (raw material, semi-finished good, or finished good) being inspected in this lot.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier or vendor for goods receipt inspection lots. Used for supplier quality performance tracking.

attributes.name: supplier_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier_site. Business justification: Supplier site-level incoming quality performance tracking and audit scheduling requires knowing which specific site shipped the lot. A quality manager comparing defect rates across a supplier's multip

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_number
attributes.description: Document number of the Certificate of Analysis issued for this inspection lot. Links to formal quality documentation in Veeva Vault.

attributes.name: coa_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the Certificate of Analysis was formally issued for this inspection lot.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the inspection lot record was first created in the quality management system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: Date when the formal usage decision was made and recorded in the quality management system.

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the usage decision was recorded. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: defect_count
attributes.description: Total number of defects or non-conformances identified during inspection. Used for quality metrics and trend analysis.

attributes.name: disposition_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome status of the lot after disposition decision and stock posting. Confirms the actual inventory movement executed.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration or best-before date assigned to the batch based on stability study results and shelf-life specifications.

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inspection lot was produced and inspected in compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice regulations.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics

attributes.name: inspection_end_date
attributes.description: Date when all inspection and testing activities were completed for this lot.

attributes.name: inspection_location
attributes.description: Physical location or quality lab where the inspection was performed. May be different from the plant code for centralized testing facilities.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the inspection lot. Externally visible alphanumeric code used in SAP QM and quality documentation for traceability and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP QM Module - Inspection Lot Number

attributes.name: inspection_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for inspector comments, observations, or special conditions noted during the inspection process.

attributes.name: inspection_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the inspection lot. Determines the sequence and urgency of inspection execution in the quality lab.

attributes.name: inspection_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the physical inspection and testing activities began for this lot.

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inspection lot. Tracks progression from creation through inspection execution to final disposition decision.
attributes.references: SAP QM Module - Inspection Lot Status

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inspection lot based on the triggering event. Determines the inspection plan template and sampling strategy applied.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the inspection lot record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: lot_origin_number
attributes.description: Document number of the originating transaction (production order number, purchase order number, delivery number, etc.) that triggered this inspection lot.

attributes.name: lot_origin_type
attributes.description: Source document type that triggered the creation of this inspection lot. Links the quality inspection to the originating business transaction.

attributes.name: lot_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of material in the inspection lot. Represents the population from which samples are drawn for inspection.

attributes.name: lot_quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the lot quantity (each, kilogram, liter, meter, etc.). Aligns with material master UOM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|L|M|M2|M3|BOX|CASE — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Business material code (SKU) of the product being inspected. Used for cross-reference and reporting.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or facility code where the inspection is performed. Aligns with SAP plant master data.

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lot is under regulatory hold pending additional review or approval from regulatory affairs or quality assurance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the lot is under regulatory hold. Documents the specific compliance or quality concern requiring additional review.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 - Current Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date when the material must be re-inspected to confirm continued compliance with quality specifications. Applicable for raw materials and intermediates.

attributes.name: sample_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material drawn as a sample for inspection testing. Determined by the inspection plan sampling procedure.

attributes.name: sample_quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the sample quantity drawn for testing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|L|M|M2|M3|BOX|CASE — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: stock_posting_instruction
attributes.description: Instruction for inventory movement based on the usage decision. Determines the target stock type for material posting in warehouse management.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Warehouse storage location code where the inspected material is held during quality inspection.

attributes.name: usage_decision
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the inspected lot. Determines whether material can be released for use, must be reworked, or should be rejected.

attributes.name: usage_decision_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the usage decision. Used for automated stock posting and reporting in SAP QM.
attributes.references: SAP QM Module - Usage Decision Codes

products.name: inspection_result
products.description: Granular QC measurement and test result records captured at the characteristic level within an inspection lot. Stores measured values, upper/lower specification limits, pass/fail status, instrument used, inspector ID, and timestamp. Supports SPC (Statistical Process Control) and GMP audit trails per ISO 9001 and GMP requirements.

attributes.name: inspection_result_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inspection result record. Primary key for granular QC (Quality Control) measurement and test result records captured at the characteristic level within an inspection lot.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent inspection lot under which this characteristic-level result was captured. Links to the inspection lot entity that groups multiple inspection results for a batch or production run.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the physical sample from which this measurement was taken. Enables traceability back to the specific sample unit within the inspection lot.

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.specification. Business justification: Link inspection_result to its governing specification for easy access to spec limits and versioning.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of this inspection result by a quality supervisor or manager. Pending indicates awaiting review; approved indicates result accepted; rejected indicates result invalidated and retest required.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this inspection result was approved. Required for GMP audit trails and batch release decision traceability.

attributes.name: coa_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this result should be included in the Certificate of Analysis (COA) document for the batch. True indicates inclusion; false indicates internal-only result.

attributes.name: control_chart_rule_violated
attributes.description: Description of the specific SPC control chart rule that was violated (e.g., point beyond control limit, 7 consecutive points above centerline, 2 of 3 points beyond 2-sigma). Populated when control_chart_violation_flag is true.

attributes.name: control_chart_violation_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this measurement violates SPC (Statistical Process Control) control chart rules (e.g., out of control limits, run rules, trend rules). True indicates a violation requiring investigation.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which this inspection result was captured (e.g., SAP QM, LIMS, Veeva Vault, manual entry). Used for data lineage and audit purposes.

attributes.name: defect_code
attributes.description: Standardized code classifying the type of defect or non-conformance observed when result_status is fail. Used for defect trending and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: defect_severity
attributes.description: Classification of the severity of the non-conformance. Critical defects pose safety or regulatory risk; major defects affect functionality; minor defects are cosmetic or non-functional.
attributes.references: ISO 2859 Sampling Procedures for Inspection by Attributes

attributes.name: deviation_code
attributes.description: Reference to an approved deviation or waiver document that authorizes acceptance of a non-conforming result. Populated when result_status is waived.

attributes.name: environmental_condition_humidity
attributes.description: Relative humidity (percentage) at the time of measurement. Critical for tests sensitive to moisture levels.

attributes.name: environmental_condition_temperature
attributes.description: Ambient temperature (in degrees Celsius) at the time of measurement. Critical for tests sensitive to environmental conditions.

attributes.name: inspection_characteristic_code
attributes.description: Unique code identifying the specific quality characteristic being measured (e.g., pH level, viscosity, weight, color, microbial count). Corresponds to the master inspection characteristic definition.

attributes.name: inspection_characteristic_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the quality characteristic being tested (e.g., Product pH, Net Weight, Microbial Load, Color Consistency).

attributes.name: inspection_method_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the standardized test method or procedure used to perform this measurement (e.g., ASTM method, USP method, internal SOP number).

attributes.name: inspection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this specific characteristic measurement was performed. Critical for time-sensitive tests and GMP audit trails.

attributes.name: instrument_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the measurement instrument or equipment used to capture this result (e.g., balance ID, pH meter ID, spectrophotometer ID). Required for GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) audit trails and instrument calibration traceability.

attributes.name: laboratory_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the laboratory or testing facility where this measurement was performed. May be an internal QC lab or an external contract lab.

attributes.name: lower_specification_limit
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable value for this characteristic as defined in the product specification or quality standard. Values below this threshold indicate non-conformance.

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: The actual quantitative measurement or test result value recorded during inspection. For qualitative characteristics, this may be encoded numerically or stored as a code.

attributes.name: measurement_uncertainty
attributes.description: Quantified estimate of the uncertainty or error margin associated with the measured value. Required for ISO 17025 compliance and advanced SPC (Statistical Process Control) analysis.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this inspection result record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this inspection result record was last modified. Audit trail field for data governance and change tracking.

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this result must be reported to regulatory authorities (e.g., FDA, EPA) due to non-conformance or safety concerns. True indicates reportable event.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 GMP for Finished Pharmaceuticals

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text comments or observations recorded by the inspector regarding this measurement. May include notes on sample condition, procedural deviations, or contextual information.

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Pass/fail status of this individual characteristic measurement. Pass indicates the measured value is within specification limits; fail indicates non-conformance; conditional indicates acceptance with restrictions; pending indicates awaiting review; waived indicates non-conformance accepted by authorized deviation.

attributes.name: retest_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this result is a retest of a previously failed or inconclusive measurement. True indicates this is a retest; false indicates initial test.

attributes.name: retest_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for retesting this characteristic. Applicable only when retest_indicator is true.

attributes.name: sample_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of this sample within the inspection lot (e.g., 1, 2, 3). Used to track sampling order and support statistical sampling plans.
attributes.references: ISO 2859 Sampling Procedures for Inspection by Attributes

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The ideal or nominal value for this characteristic. Used for process capability analysis and SPC (Statistical Process Control) charting.

attributes.name: test_batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or run number of the test reagents or consumables used during this measurement. Required for traceability in regulated environments.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the measured value is expressed (e.g., grams, milliliters, pH units, CFU/g for colony forming units per gram, percentage).

attributes.name: upper_specification_limit
attributes.description: The maximum acceptable value for this characteristic as defined in the product specification or quality standard. Values above this threshold indicate non-conformance.

products.name: usage_decision
products.description: Records the formal QC usage decision made at the conclusion of an inspection lot — accept, reject, restricted use, or rework. Captures decision code, decision maker, decision date, stock posting instruction, and regulatory hold flag. Drives downstream batch release and inventory disposition in SAP QM/MM.

attributes.name: usage_decision_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the quality control usage decision record. Primary key.

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CAPA record initiated as a result of this usage decision, if applicable. Null if no CAPA was required.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Usage decisions (reject/rework/accept) trigger material disposition costs charged to cost centers. Rework labor and scrap write-offs must be attributed to the responsible QC cost center for period-end

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Usage decisions drive material valuation postings (stock write-offs for rejections, rework charges) to specific GL accounts. Consumer goods QM-FI integration requires the GL account for automatic acco

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.goods_receipt. Business justification: The usage decision (accept/reject/rework) directly determines whether a goods receipt is fully posted, reversed, or blocked in the warehouse. This link is required for the quality-gate-to-stock-postin

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inspection lot for which this usage decision was made. Links to the QC inspection lot that was evaluated.

attributes.name: inventory_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.inventory_position. Business justification: Usage decisions (accept/reject/quarantine/rework) directly drive inventory_status changes in the WMS. Quality disposition must reference the specific inventory position to post stock movements. This i

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or product that was inspected and for which the usage decision applies.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.distribution_storage_location. Business justification: usage_decision.storage_location_code is a denormalized reference to distribution_storage_location. After disposition, rejected/rework stock is directed to a specific storage location (e.g., returns ar

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor who provided the material, if applicable. Used for supplier quality management and vendor scorecarding.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when the usage decision was formally approved by authorized quality management personnel. Null if no approval was required.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this usage decision requires additional management or quality assurance approval before batch release. True=Approval required, False=No additional approval needed.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The production batch or lot number to which this usage decision applies. Critical for traceability and recall management.

attributes.name: capa_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this usage decision triggers a CAPA process due to significant non-conformance. True=CAPA required, False=No CAPA needed. Links to continuous improvement.

tag_set.value: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Certificate of Analysis document that supports this usage decision. Links to detailed test results and specifications.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional free-text comments or notes related to the usage decision. May include special handling instructions, escalation notes, or contextual information.

attributes.name: decision_code
attributes.description: The formal quality control usage decision code. A=Accept (Unrestricted Use), R=Reject, Q=Quality Hold, S=Restricted Use (Sample/Scrap), X=Rework Required. Drives downstream inventory disposition.

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the usage decision was formally made and recorded. Critical for compliance timelines and batch release tracking.

attributes.name: decision_maker_name
attributes.description: Full name of the quality control inspector or authorized personnel who made the usage decision. Captured for audit and traceability purposes.

attributes.name: decision_text
attributes.description: Detailed textual description or rationale for the usage decision. Captures the quality assessor's reasoning and any special conditions or instructions.

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the usage decision was recorded in the system. Provides audit trail precision for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: defect_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the primary defect or non-conformance that led to rejection or restricted use decision. Used for root cause analysis and trend reporting.

attributes.name: defect_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the defect, non-conformance, or quality issue identified during inspection. Supports CAPA and continuous improvement processes.

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: The date when the material disposition action was completed (e.g., stock posted to unrestricted, blocked, or scrapped). Null if disposition is still pending.

attributes.name: disposition_status
attributes.description: Current status of the material disposition action following the usage decision. pending=Decision made but stock not yet moved, completed=Stock posting completed, cancelled=Decision reversed or voided.

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the batch meets Good Manufacturing Practice requirements. True=GMP compliant, False=Non-compliant. Required for pharmaceutical and cosmetic products.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: The type of quality inspection that led to this usage decision. goods_receipt=incoming material inspection, in_process=during production, final=finished goods, stability=shelf-life testing, complaint=customer complaint investigation.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The manufacturing plant or facility code where the inspection and usage decision were performed. Critical for multi-site quality management.

attributes.name: quantity_accepted
attributes.description: The quantity of material accepted for unrestricted use based on the usage decision. Measured in the material's base unit of measure.

attributes.name: quantity_rejected
attributes.description: The quantity of material rejected and not suitable for use. Measured in the material's base unit of measure. May trigger disposal or return to supplier.

attributes.name: quantity_rework
attributes.description: The quantity of material designated for rework or reprocessing to meet quality standards. Measured in the material's base unit of measure.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this usage decision record was first created in the lakehouse. Part of the audit trail for data governance.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this usage decision record was last updated in the lakehouse. Tracks data freshness and change history.

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material is under regulatory hold and cannot be released for distribution. True=Hold in effect, False=No regulatory hold. Critical for FDA and EPA compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 Current Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the material is under regulatory hold. May reference specific test failures, compliance issues, or pending regulatory approvals.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 Current Good Manufacturing Practice

attributes.name: sampling_procedure
attributes.description: The sampling method or procedure used during the inspection (e.g., random sampling, statistical sampling, 100% inspection). Ensures inspection validity.
attributes.references: ISO 2859 Sampling Procedures for Inspection by Attributes

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this usage decision record in the source operational system. Enables traceability back to the system of record.

attributes.name: stock_posting_instruction
attributes.description: Instruction for how the inspected material should be posted to inventory. Determines the stock type and availability for use: unrestricted (available for sale/use), blocked (not available), quality_inspection (under evaluation), scrap (to be disposed), sample (for testing), rework (to be reprocessed).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantities in this usage decision (e.g., EA=Each, KG=Kilogram, L=Liter, CS=Case). Aligns with material master UOM.

products.name: nonconformance
products.description: Unified quality event record for non-conformances, deviations, quality notifications, and improvement requests identified during manufacturing, QC inspection, supplier receipt, or customer complaint escalation. Captures event type (complaint, defect, deviation, improvement request), defect description, defect classification, affected batch/SKU, detection source, severity, priority, containment actions, task assignments, responsible plant, and linkage to CAPA. Serves as the single routing point for all quality events across SAP QM notifications and Veeva Vault workflows. Aligns with ISO 9001:2015 clause 10.2 and GMP deviation reporting requirements.

attributes.name: nonconformance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the nonconformance record. Primary key for the nonconformance data product.

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the CAPA record created to address the root cause of this nonconformance. Links to capa_record for tracking corrective and preventive actions.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost of quality report allocates nonconformance financial impact to responsible cost center for internal cost tracking.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Nonconformances carry financial_impact_amount requiring GL account assignment for posting scrap, rework, and quality failure costs. Consumer goods companies post nonconformance costs to dedicated qual

attributes.name: inbound_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.inbound_receipt. Business justification: Required for receipt quality control: nonconformance must reference the inbound receipt that triggered the issue, enabling tracking of receipt-level defects and corrective actions.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_lot. Business justification: A nonconformance is frequently triggered by a failed or anomalous inspection lot (e.g., a rejected goods receipt inspection or an in-process QC failure). Adding inspection_lot_id to nonconformance est

attributes.name: inventory_position_id

Stores complaint source (consumer, retailer, regulatory), product SKU, batch number, complaint category (foreign body, contamination, labeling, efficacy), severity, investigation status, regulatory reportability flag, and resolution outcome. Integrates with Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud and Veeva Vault.

attributes.name: product_complaint_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product complaint record. Primary key.

attributes.name: capa_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this complaint to a formal CAPA record if one was initiated.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Financial impact of product complaints is allocated to a cost center for cost‑of‑quality reporting.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promotion_event. Business justification: Post-event quality review process: consumer goods companies correlate complaint spikes with specific promotion events. promotion_event has post_event_analysis_completed_flag — linking complaints enabl

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.invoice. Business justification: Complaints require invoice reference for financial resolution (credit memo issuance, refund processing) and to validate purchase authenticity. Standard consumer goods complaint handling workflow links

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.manufacturing_facility. Business justification: When a complaint triggers enforcement, a regulatory action is opened; linking enables tracking complaint to action.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Consumer complaints typically reference the originating sales order for traceability, root cause analysis (was it shipped from a specific batch/facility?), and customer service resolution (refund, rep

attributes.name: outbound_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.outbound_order_line. Business justification: Required for complaint traceability: product complaint must reference the outbound order line that delivered the product, allowing root cause analysis and customer service reporting.

attributes.name: product_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_category. Business justification: Customer complaints can launch a new R&D project for product improvement; linking captures that initiation relationship.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Product complaint handling costs and remediation expenses are tracked by profit center for brand P&L in consumer goods. This link enables complaint cost reporting by brand/category, supporting brand m

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.retail_store. Business justification: Store‑level complaint tracking required for quality investigations and performance dashboards; linking complaints to the retail store where purchase occurred is standard in consumer‑goods.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.shipment. Business justification: Associates customer complaints with the originating shipment for traceability, recall decisions, and service recovery.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consumer.shopper. Business justification: Complaint handling process requires linking each product complaint to the shopper who reported it for traceability and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Complaints are investigated per SKU; linking enables root‑cause analysis, corrective actions, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Complaints must be tied to the responsible supplier for performance monitoring and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the retail or trade account where the product was purchased, if applicable.

attributes.name: trade_promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.trade_promotion. Business justification: Promotion-linked complaint trend analysis: consumer goods quality teams report complaint rates by trade promotion to identify promotions driving quality failures. Enables regulatory and commercial rep

attributes.name: complainant_address
attributes.description: Mailing address of the complainant for correspondence and product sample return.

attributes.name: complainant_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the complainant location.

attributes.name: complainant_email
attributes.description: Email address of the complainant for follow-up communication.

attributes.name: complainant_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual or organization filing the complaint.

attributes.name: complainant_phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number of the complainant.

attributes.name: complaint_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the complaint type based on the nature of the quality issue reported.

attributes.name: complaint_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the complaint as reported by the complainant, including symptoms, observations, and circumstances.

attributes.name: complaint_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique complaint reference number used for tracking and communication with consumers and regulatory bodies.

attributes.name: complaint_received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the complaint was first received by the organization.

attributes.name: complaint_source
attributes.description: Origin channel through which the complaint was received.

attributes.name: complaint_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the complaint investigation and resolution process.

attributes.name: complaint_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed sub-classification providing additional granularity to the complaint category.

attributes.name: corrective_action
attributes.description: Description of corrective actions taken to address the immediate complaint.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the complaint record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Product expiration or best-before date printed on the package.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number uniquely identifying the product in the supply chain.

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: Date when the consumer or customer experienced the quality issue or adverse event.

attributes.name: investigation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the investigation was concluded and findings documented.

attributes.name: investigation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the formal investigation of the complaint was initiated.

attributes.name: investigation_status
attributes.description: Current state of the internal quality investigation process.

attributes.name: lab_analysis_result
attributes.description: Summary of laboratory test results conducted on the returned product sample.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the complaint record was last updated.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: Date when the product batch was manufactured.

attributes.name: preventive_action
attributes.description: Description of preventive actions implemented to prevent recurrence of similar issues.

attributes.name: purchase_date
attributes.description: Date when the complainant purchased the product.

attributes.name: regulatory_agency
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory agency to which the complaint was reported (e.g., FDA, EPA, CPSC).

attributes.name: regulatory_case_number
attributes.description: Case or reference number assigned by the regulatory agency for tracking purposes.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: Date when the complaint was reported to the relevant regulatory authority.

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this complaint must be reported to regulatory authorities such as FDA, EPA, or CPSC.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date when the complaint was resolved and closed.

attributes.name: resolution_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome or action taken to resolve the complaint with the complainant.

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Identified root cause of the quality issue based on investigation findings.

attributes.name: sample_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the returned product sample was received by the quality assurance team.

attributes.name: sample_returned_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the complainant returned a physical product sample for laboratory analysis.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Risk classification indicating the potential impact to consumer safety and business reputation.

products.name: specification
products.description: Master data defining quality specifications for raw materials, packaging, in-process intermediates, and finished goods. Stores specification type, test characteristic, unit of measure, target value, upper/lower specification limits (USL/LSL), test method reference, and effective date range. Serves as the authoritative specification repository linked to inspection plans and CoA generation.

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the quality specification record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Specification development, maintenance, and review activities are charged to R&D or QA cost centers. Consumer goods companies track specification management costs by cost center for R&D capitalization

attributes.name: inspection_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP QM inspection plan that uses this specification. Links specification to operational quality control procedures.

attributes.name: product_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_category. Business justification: Specifications are developed within an R&D project; linking ties each spec to its originating project for governance.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Specifications are owned by product lines/brands mapped to profit centers. Linking specifications to profit centers enables brand-level quality cost reporting and supports transfer pricing for specifi

attributes.name: specification_material_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or product this specification applies to. Links to the master material record in SAP MM.

attributes.name: specification_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Quality specifications are defined per SKU to ensure manufacturing compliance and product release criteria.

attributes.name: superseded_by_specification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer specification that replaces this one when status is superseded. Maintains specification version lineage.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this specification was formally approved for use. Part of the specification lifecycle audit trail.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the type of quality attribute being specified. Groups related test characteristics for reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: coa_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether test results for this specification must be included on the Certificate of Analysis provided to customers. Drives CoA generation logic.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this specification record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for compliance and traceability.

attributes.name: critical_quality_attribute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this characteristic is a Critical Quality Attribute that directly impacts product safety, efficacy, or regulatory compliance. CQAs require enhanced controls and documentation.

attributes.name: customer_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specification is driven by specific customer contractual requirements rather than internal or regulatory standards.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this specification is no longer valid. Null indicates an open-ended specification. Used for specification versioning and supersession.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this specification becomes valid and must be used for quality control testing. Supports time-based specification management.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this specification record was last updated. Tracks change history for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: lower_specification_limit
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable value for the test characteristic. Results below this limit indicate non-conformance.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this specification. Used for compliance tracking and specification maintenance planning.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional context, special instructions, or clarifications related to this specification. May include testing conditions, sample preparation requirements, or interpretation guidance.

attributes.name: review_frequency_months
attributes.description: How often this specification must be reviewed and revalidated, expressed in months. Ensures specifications remain current and appropriate.

attributes.name: sampling_plan
attributes.description: Description of the sampling methodology and sample size requirements for this test (e.g., AQL 2.5, n=10, ANSI/ASQ Z1.4). Ensures statistical validity of test results.
attributes.references: ISO 2859 Sampling Procedures for Inspection by Attributes

attributes.name: specification_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the quality specification, used for external reference and documentation. Unique across the organization.

attributes.name: specification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the specification. Only active specifications are used for quality control and Certificate of Analysis (CoA) generation.

attributes.name: specification_type
attributes.description: Classification of the specification based on the material or product stage it applies to. Determines the applicable quality control procedures.

attributes.name: stability_indicating_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test characteristic is used in stability studies to monitor product degradation over time. Critical for shelf-life determination.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The ideal or nominal value for the test characteristic. Represents the center point of the acceptable range.

attributes.name: test_characteristic
attributes.description: The specific quality attribute or property being measured or tested (e.g., pH, viscosity, color, weight, purity, microbial count). Defines what is being inspected.

attributes.name: test_equipment_required
attributes.description: Description of specialized equipment or instrumentation needed to perform this test (e.g., HPLC, spectrophotometer, viscometer). Supports resource planning and capability assessment.

attributes.name: test_frequency
attributes.description: How often this test characteristic must be measured during production or quality control. Drives inspection plan scheduling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: per_batch|per_lot|hourly|daily|weekly|monthly|on_demand — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: test_method_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the standard test method or procedure used to measure the characteristic (e.g., ASTM D1475, USP 621, internal SOP number). Ensures consistent testing methodology.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the test characteristic is measured (e.g., mg/L, %, pH units, cP, CFU/g). Critical for interpreting specification limits.

attributes.name: upper_specification_limit
attributes.description: The maximum acceptable value for the test characteristic. Results above this limit indicate non-conformance.

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the controlled document in Veeva Vault that contains the full specification details and supporting documentation. Ensures document control and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the specification to track revisions and changes over time. Follows major.minor versioning convention.

domains.name: distribution
domains.description: Owns warehouse operations, inventory management, and order fulfillment across distribution centers. Manages inbound/outbound logistics within DCs, put-away/picking/packing processes, cycle counting, FEFO/FIFO inventory rotation, WMS integration (Blue Yonder), OTIF performance, OSA metrics, and DSD execution for direct store delivery channels.

products.name: distribution_facility
products.description: Master record for each physical distribution center (DC) or warehouse facility in the CPG network. Captures DC identity, location, type (ambient, chilled, frozen, DSD hub), capacity metrics, WMS integration identifiers (Blue Yonder site codes), SAP plant/storage location mappings, operating hours, and operational status. SSOT for DC facility master data across the distribution domain.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Primary key for facility

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Each distribution facility belongs to a legal entity (company code) for statutory reporting, intercompany billing between DCs, and tax compliance. Multi-entity consumer goods companies require this fo

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: DC facility operating costs (labor, utilities, lease) are tracked against a cost center for overhead allocation and logistics budget management. Every consumer goods DC is assigned a cost center in SA

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the distribution center facility. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, building, or unit information. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the distribution center is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the distribution center ceased operations. Null for active facilities. Used for historical analysis and network optimization studies.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary contact email address for the distribution center. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the distribution center. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the distribution center is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distribution center record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: cross_dock_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility supports cross-docking operations where inbound goods are directly transferred to outbound shipments with minimal storage time.

attributes.name: cycle_count_frequency_days
attributes.description: Standard frequency in days for cycle counting inventory at this facility. Used for inventory accuracy management and audit compliance.

attributes.name: dc_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the distribution center used across operational systems. Externally-known unique code for the facility.

attributes.name: dc_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the distribution center or warehouse facility.

attributes.name: dock_doors_inbound
attributes.description: Number of dock doors designated for inbound receiving operations. Impacts receiving throughput capacity and scheduling.

attributes.name: dock_doors_outbound
attributes.description: Number of dock doors designated for outbound shipping operations. Impacts shipping throughput capacity and carrier scheduling.

attributes.name: dsd_hub_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this facility serves as a DSD hub for direct-to-retail delivery operations. DSD hubs bypass traditional distribution channels for faster store replenishment.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution center based on temperature control and operational model. Ambient for room temperature, chilled for refrigerated, frozen for sub-zero, multi-temperature for mixed zones, DSD hub for Direct Store Delivery operations, cross-dock for flow-through distribution.

attributes.name: fsc_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is certified under FSC chain of custody standards for sustainable sourcing. Required for handling FSC-certified paper and wood-based products.
attributes.references: Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) Chain of Custody Certification

attributes.name: gmp_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is certified under Good Manufacturing Practice standards. Required for handling cosmetics, personal care, and certain consumer goods products.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is certified to handle and store hazardous materials. Required for distribution of products with EPA or OSHA regulated substances.

attributes.name: inventory_rotation_method
attributes.description: Primary inventory rotation method used at this facility. FIFO (First In First Out) for standard goods, FEFO (First Expired First Out) for perishables and date-sensitive products, LIFO (Last In First Out) for specific use cases.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the distribution center in decimal degrees. Used for geospatial analytics, route optimization, and logistics planning.

attributes.name: lease_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the facility lease agreement. Null for owned facilities. Used for lease renewal planning and facility strategy.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the distribution center in decimal degrees. Used for geospatial analytics, route optimization, and logistics planning.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this distribution center record was last modified. Audit trail for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: Date when the distribution center commenced operations. Used for facility age analysis and depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: operating_hours_weekday
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for weekdays in format HH:MM-HH:MM. Used for scheduling inbound deliveries, outbound shipments, and workforce planning.

attributes.name: operating_hours_weekend
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for weekends in format HH:MM-HH:MM. Used for scheduling weekend operations and carrier coordination.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the distribution center in its lifecycle. Active indicates full operations, inactive for temporarily closed, under construction for new facilities being built, decommissioned for permanently closed, seasonal for facilities operating only during peak periods, maintenance for temporary closure due to upgrades or repairs.

attributes.name: osa_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target OSA performance percentage for stores served by this distribution center. OSA measures product availability at retail shelf level.

attributes.name: otif_target_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Target Percentage
attributes.description: Target OTIF performance percentage for this distribution center. OTIF measures the percentage of orders delivered on time and in full, a key supply chain KPI.

tag_set.value: On Time In Full (OTIF) Target Percentage

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Classification of facility ownership model. Owned for company-owned facilities, leased for long-term leased properties, third-party logistics for 3PL-operated warehouses.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the distribution center address. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: sap_plant_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA plant code representing this distribution center in the ERP system. Maps to the SAP MM and WM modules for material management and warehouse management.

attributes.name: sap_storage_location
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA storage location code within the plant. Represents the primary storage location identifier for inventory transactions in SAP WM module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Storage Location Master Data

attributes.name: shifts_per_day
attributes.description: Number of operational shifts per day at the facility. Used for labor planning, throughput capacity modeling, and operational cost analysis.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or regional administrative division where the facility is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_pallet_positions
attributes.description: Maximum number of pallet positions available for storage. Key metric for inventory capacity planning and space utilization analysis.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility has temperature-controlled storage zones. True for facilities with chilled or frozen capabilities, false for ambient-only.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the distribution center location. Used for scheduling, shift planning, and cross-facility coordination.

attributes.name: total_capacity_sqft
attributes.description: Total warehouse floor space capacity in square feet. Includes all storage, staging, and operational areas within the facility.

attributes.name: wms_site_code
attributes.description: Unique site identifier in the Blue Yonder WMS system. Used for integration and synchronization between the lakehouse and the operational WMS platform.

products.name: storage_location
products.description: Granular storage location master within a distribution center — aisles, bays, levels, bin positions, and pick faces as defined in Blue Yonder WMS. Tracks location type (bulk, pick, reserve, staging, dock), zone classification, temperature zone, weight/volume capacity, and FEFO/FIFO eligibility flags. Enables put-away and picking optimization at the slot level.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Primary key for storage_location

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent distribution center facility where this storage location resides.

attributes.name: product_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.category. Business justification: DC slotting optimization and putaway strategy designate storage locations for specific product categories (e.g., hazmat zones, temperature zones, promotional zones). Category-based slotting is a named

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: Velocity-based classification of the location for slotting optimization: A (high-velocity/fast-moving), B (medium-velocity), C (low-velocity/slow-moving).

attributes.name: aisle
attributes.description: Aisle designation within the warehouse layout for physical navigation and picking route optimization.

attributes.name: bay
attributes.description: Bay or column position within the aisle for precise horizontal location reference.

attributes.name: bin_position
attributes.description: Specific bin or slot position within the level for granular inventory placement and retrieval.

attributes.name: blocked_date
attributes.description: Date when the storage location was blocked or made unavailable for operations.

attributes.name: blocked_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the location is blocked or unavailable, such as maintenance, damage, safety hold, or quality quarantine.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the storage location record was first created in the WMS system.

attributes.name: cycle_count_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency for cycle counting inventory at this location to maintain inventory accuracy and compliance.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Cycle Count Configuration

attributes.name: distribution_storage_location_level
attributes.description: Vertical level or shelf position within the bay for height-based slotting and equipment compatibility.

attributes.name: dsd_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location is designated for DSD operations where products bypass the DC and are delivered directly to retail stores.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the storage location became active and available for warehouse operations.

attributes.name: equipment_type_required
attributes.description: Type of material handling equipment required to access this storage location for put-away and picking operations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the storage location is scheduled to be decommissioned or removed from active use. Null for indefinite locations.

attributes.name: fefo_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: First Expired First Out (FEFO) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location supports FEFO inventory rotation logic for expiry-sensitive products (pharmaceuticals, food, cosmetics).

tag_set.value: First Expired First Out (FEFO) Eligible Flag

attributes.name: fifo_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: First In First Out (FIFO) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location supports FIFO inventory rotation logic for age-based stock management.

tag_set.value: First In First Out (FIFO) Eligible Flag

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location is certified and equipped for storing hazardous materials per OSHA and EPA regulations.

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: Physical height dimension of the storage location in centimeters for vertical clearance and equipment reach validation.

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent cycle count was performed at this storage location.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Cycle Count History

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the storage location record was most recently updated in the WMS system.

attributes.name: length_cm
attributes.description: Physical length dimension of the storage location in centimeters for dimensional slotting and equipment compatibility.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the storage location as defined in Blue Yonder WMS. Typically formatted as aisle-bay-level-bin (e.g., A01-B05-L03-P12).

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the storage location for operational reference.

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the storage location indicating availability for inventory placement and retrieval.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storage location by operational function: bulk storage, active pick face, reserve inventory, staging area, dock door, or cross-dock zone.

attributes.name: mixed_lot_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location permits storage of multiple lot or batch numbers for the same SKU or requires lot segregation.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Location Master, GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: mixed_sku_allowed_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mixed Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) Allowed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location permits storage of multiple SKUs simultaneously or requires single-SKU dedication.

tag_set.value: Mixed Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) Allowed Flag

attributes.name: pick_face_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location is designated as an active pick face for order fulfillment operations.

attributes.name: picking_strategy
attributes.description: Order fulfillment picking method supported by this location: batch picking, wave picking, zone picking, discrete (single-order), or cluster picking.

attributes.name: putaway_strategy
attributes.description: Algorithm used to assign incoming inventory to this location: directed (system-assigned), random, fixed (dedicated SKU), or dynamic (velocity-based).

attributes.name: replenishment_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for automated replenishment from reserve to pick locations, with lower numbers indicating higher priority.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature control classification for the storage location to ensure product integrity and regulatory compliance (ambient, refrigerated 2-8°C, frozen <-18°C, controlled room temperature).

attributes.name: volume_capacity_m3
attributes.description: Maximum volume capacity of the storage location in cubic meters for space utilization and slotting algorithms.

attributes.name: weight_capacity_kg
attributes.description: Maximum weight capacity of the storage location in kilograms for safe load management and slotting optimization.

attributes.name: width_cm
attributes.description: Physical width dimension of the storage location in centimeters for dimensional slotting and equipment compatibility.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Logical zone classification within the distribution center for grouping locations by product category, velocity, or operational workflow (e.g., FAST-PICK, SLOW-MOVE, HAZMAT).

products.name: inbound_receipt
products.description: Transactional record capturing the physical receipt of goods at a DC from suppliers, manufacturing plants, or inter-DC transfers. Records ASN reference, carrier, trailer/container ID, dock door, receipt date/time, received quantity by SKU/lot, temperature check results, and discrepancy flags. Integrates with SAP WM goods receipt and Blue Yonder WMS inbound processing. Drives inventory on-hand updates and FEFO/FIFO lot registration.

attributes.name: inbound_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inbound receipt transaction. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Inbound receipts are posted against a specific legal entity for 3-way match processing, statutory inventory accounting, and intercompany goods receipt reconciliation. Required for correct AP invoice m

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Receiving operations incur expenses (labor, equipment) that are allocated to a cost center for expense tracking and budgeting.

attributes.name: demand_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.demand_plan. Business justification: Inbound receipts planned against demand plans for synchronized replenishment timing. Essential for S&OP execution tracking, plan vs. actual receipt variance analysis, and demand-supply synchronization

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Goods receipt postings debit the inventory GL account and credit GR/IR clearing. The inbound_receipt must reference the GL account to support 3-way match (PO/GR/Invoice) and inventory valuation postin

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.manufacturing_facility. Business justification: Internal transfer receipt: inbound receipts from own plants need the source manufacturing facility to track internal logistics and cost allocation.

attributes.name: primary_inbound_distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution center facility where the goods were received.

attributes.name: product_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_category. Business justification: Required for R&D material receipt tracking; links each inbound receipt to the RD project that requested the raw material for formulation trials.

domains.name: promotion
domains.description: Owns trade promotion planning, execution, and optimization (TPM/TPO). Manages promotional calendars, trade spend allocation, retailer funding agreements, promotional pricing (Hi-Lo, EDLP), accruals, deductions, post-event analysis, promotional lift measurement, ROI/GMROI analysis, and retailer rebate settlements. Integrates with Salesforce TPM.

products.name: trade_promotion
products.description: Core master entity for trade promotion programs. Captures the full definition of a trade promotion including name, type (Hi-Lo, EDLP, display, coupon, scan-back, off-invoice), promotional period, owning brand/category, status (planned, active, closed, cancelled), total authorized trade spend budget, promotion objectives, promotion type classification (temporary price reduction, feature ad, display, BOGO, multi-buy, scan-back, coupon, loyalty reward), applicable channels, and integration reference to Salesforce TPM. Serves as the SSOT for all trade promotion definitions and the parent entity for all promotion events, spend allocations, and post-event analyses.

Captures deduction number, retailer account, invoice reference, deduction amount, deduction type (promotional, pricing, shortage, compliance), deduction date, dispute status (open, approved, disputed, written-off), and complete settlement details: settlement date, settlement method (credit memo, check, offset against future invoice, write-off), settled amount, approved amount, disputed amount, settlement reason code, approver, and linkage to originating promotion event and funding agreement. Serves as the single entity for the entire deduction management workflow — no separate settlement record exists. Central to trade spend reconciliation, dispute resolution, and retailer relationship management.

attributes.name: valid_from_date

attributes.name: valid_to_date
